### PaymentMethod Model

**Properties:**
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | bigint | Primary key |
| `user_id` | bigint | Foreign key to users |
| `stripe_customer_id` | string | Stripe customer ID (cus_...) |
| `stripe_payment_method_id` | string | Stripe payment method ID (pm_...) |
| `provider` | string | Payment provider (default: 'stripe') |
| `brand` | string | Card brand (visa, mastercard, amex) |
| `last_four` | string | Last 4 digits of card |
| `exp_month` | int | Expiration month |
| `exp_year` | int | Expiration year |
| `is_default` | bool | Whether this is the default method |

**Relationships:**
| Relationship | Type | Description |
|--------------|------|-------------|
| `user()` | BelongsTo | User who owns this payment method |

| `expiry_date` | Formatted MM/YY string |

### Database Schema

**payment_methods table:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE payment_methods (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    stripe_customer_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    stripe_payment_method_id VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    provider VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'stripe',
    brand VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    last_four VARCHAR(4) NULL,
    exp_month INT NULL,
    exp_year INT NULL,
    is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE KEY payment_methods_user_stripe_unique (user_id, stripe_payment_method_id),
    INDEX payment_methods_stripe_customer_index (stripe_customer_id)
);
```

### StripeGatewayService Integration

The `StripeGatewayService` provides the following methods for payment method management:

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getPaymentMethods(User $user)` | Fetch payment methods from Stripe customer |
| `deletePaymentMethod(string $paymentMethodId)` | Detach payment method from Stripe |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| User Isolation | User can only access their own payment methods |
| Ownership Verification | Delete requires user ownership check |
| Route Constraint | `->where('id', '[0-9]+')` prevents SQL injection |
| No Sensitive Data | Card numbers stored by Stripe, not locally |
| 404 for Unauthorized | Returns 404 (not 403) to prevent enumeration |

### Default Payment Method Logic

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Deleting non-default method | Removed, default unchanged |
| Deleting default (multiple methods) | Next available becomes default |
| Deleting default (only method) | Rejected with 422 error |

## PayPalGatewayService (TASK-26-12)

### Service Description
PayPal payment gateway service implementing `PaymentGatewayInterface` for credit purchases. Uses PayPal Orders API v2 for payment processing with full webhook signature verification, idempotency handling, and security measures. Alternative payment method to Stripe for the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/PayPalGatewayService.php`
- **Interface:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/Contracts/PaymentGatewayInterface.php`
- **Exception:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/Exceptions/PayPalPaymentException.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Billing/PayPalGatewayServiceTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `createPaymentIntent(User $user, float $amount, string $currency, array $metadata)` | Create PayPal order with return/cancel URLs |
| `capturePayment(string $orderId, array $options)` | Capture approved PayPal order |
| `refundPayment(string $captureId, float $amount = null)` | Refund captured payment (full or partial) |
| `handleWebhook(Request $request)` | Process PayPal webhook events with signature verification |
| `getCustomer(User $user)` | Returns null (PayPal doesn't require customer storage) |
| `createCustomer(User $user)` | Returns payer_id from approved order |
| `getPaymentMethods(User $user)` | Returns empty array |
| `deletePaymentMethod(string $id)` | Returns false |

### PayPal Orders API v2 Integration

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Order Intent | `CAPTURE` |
| Amount Format | String ("10.00") per PayPal spec |
| Custom ID | Format: `user_{id}_package_{package_id}` |
| Return URL | Configurable via metadata |
| Cancel URL | Configurable via metadata |

### Webhook Event Handling

| Event Type | Action |
|------------|--------|
| `CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED` | Log for monitoring |
| `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` | Add credits via CreditService |
| `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.DENIED` | Mark transaction as failed |
| `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED` | Handle refund logic |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| **Webhook Signature Verification** | Required before processing any webhook event |
| Certificate URL Validation | Only accepts PayPal domains (`api.paypal.com`, `api.sandbox.paypal.com`) |
| Transmission Time Validation | 5-minute tolerance for replay attack prevention |
| Idempotency | PayPal-Request-Id header for captures and refunds |
| Duplicate Detection | CreditTransaction lookup by payment_id |
| API Credentials | Never logged, stored securely in env |

### Webhook Signature Verification Flow

```
handleWebhook(Request)
├── 1. Extract headers (PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG, CERT-URL, etc.)
├── 2. Validate certificate URL (PayPal domains only)
├── 3. Call PayPal verify-webhook-signature API
├── 4. Verify transmission time (5 min tolerance)
├── 5. If invalid → throw InvalidWebhookSignatureException
└── 6. If valid → process event
```

### Environment Configuration

```env
PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=<client_id>
PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=<client_secret>
PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID=<webhook_id>
PAYPAL_MODE=sandbox|live
PAYPAL_RETURN_URL=<return_url>
PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL=<cancel_url>
```

### Error Handling

| Error Type | Response |
|------------|----------|
| Invalid credentials | `RuntimeException` on service instantiation |
| Invalid webhook signature | `InvalidWebhookSignatureException` |
| Network timeout | `PayPalPaymentException` with retry suggestion |
| Already captured | Idempotency check returns existing transaction |
| Refund failed | `PayPalPaymentException` with error details |

## PayPal Order Endpoint (TASK-26-13)

### Endpoint Description
REST API endpoint for creating PayPal orders for credit purchase. Validates credit packages, calculates credits with bonuses, creates pending transactions, and returns PayPal order details for frontend integration. Part of the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026).

### Component Location
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Payments/PayPalOrderController.php`
- **Form Request:** `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Payments/CreatePayPalOrderRequest.php`
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/PayPalGatewayService.php`
- **Interface:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/Contracts/PaymentGatewayInterface.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/CreditTransaction.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/Payments/PayPalOrderControllerTest.php`

### API Specification

| Method | Endpoint | Authentication |
|--------|----------|----------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/payments/paypal/order` | Required (Bearer token) |

### Request Body

```json
{
  "package_id": 2,
  "return_url": "https://example.com/credits/success",
  "cancel_url": "https://example.com/credits/cancelled"
}
```

### Request Validation

| Field | Type | Required | Validation Rules |
|-------|------|----------|------------------|
| `package_id` | integer | Yes | Exists in `credit_packages` table, must be active |
| `return_url` | string | Yes | Valid URL format |
| `cancel_url` | string | Yes | Valid URL format |

### Response Format (Success)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "order_id": "5O190127TN364715T",
    "approval_url": "https://www.paypal.com/checkoutnow?token=5O190127TN364715T",
    "amount": 10.00,
    "credits": 10.50,
    "package_name": "Basic"
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `order_id` | string | PayPal order ID for SDK integration |
| `approval_url` | string | URL to redirect user for PayPal approval |
| `amount` | numeric | Package price in USD |
| `credits` | numeric | Credits to be awarded (base + bonus) |
| `package_name` | string | Display name of credit package |

### Error Responses

| Status | Condition | Response |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated request | `{"success": false, "error": "Unauthenticated"}` |
| 422 | Validation error | `{"success": false, "error": {...}, "details": {...}}` |
| 422 | Inactive package | `{"success": false, "error": "Invalid package"}` |
| 500 | PayPal API failure | `{"success": false, "error": "Failed to create order"}` |

### Controller Implementation

**PayPalOrderController@store():**
1. Validates request via `CreatePayPalOrderRequest`
2. Fetches package from database (active check included)
3. Calculates credits: `base_credits × (1 + bonus_percent/100)`
4. Creates PayPal order via `PaymentGatewayInterface`
5. Stores pending transaction with `order_id` in `payment_id` field
6. Returns order details for frontend

### Business Logic

**Credits Calculation:**
```
credits = base_credits × (1 + bonus_percent / 100)
```

**Transaction Status Flow:**
| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `pending` | Order created, awaiting user approval |
| `completed` | Order captured, credits added (TASK-26-14) |
| `failed` | Payment failed |
| `cancelled` | User cancelled |

### Database Schema

**credit_transactions table (status column added):**
```sql
ALTER TABLE credit_transactions 
ADD COLUMN status ENUM('pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') 
DEFAULT 'pending' AFTER type;
```

### PaymentGatewayInterface Integration

The endpoint uses `PaymentGatewayInterface` for dependency injection:

```php
interface PaymentGatewayInterface
{
    public function createOrder(float $amount, array $metadata = []): array;
    public function capturePayment(string $paymentId): bool;
    public function handleWebhook(Request $request): PaymentResult;
}
```

**PayPalGatewayService Implementation:**
- `createOrder()` returns `order_id` and `approval_url`
- Accepts `return_url` and `cancel_url` from metadata
- Creates order with `CAPTURE` intent

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication | Bearer token required (Sanctum) |
| Amount Validation | Price read from database, not request body |
| Package Validation | Server-side check for active status |
| Order Tracking | Order ID stored for webhook verification |
| URL Validation | Return/cancel URLs validated via FormRequest |

## PayPal Smart Buttons Support (TASK-26-15)

### Endpoint Description
REST API endpoint for capturing approved PayPal orders via Smart Buttons. Called by frontend after user approves payment in PayPal popup. Verifies order ownership, prevents double capture, and adds credits to user balance. Part of the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026).

### Component Location
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Payments/PayPalCaptureController.php`
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/PayPalGatewayService.php`
- **Interface:** `backend/app/Services/Billing/Contracts/PaymentGatewayInterface.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/CreditTransaction.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/Payments/PayPalCaptureControllerTest.php`

### API Specification

| Method | Endpoint | Authentication |
|--------|----------|----------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/payments/paypal/capture` | Required (Bearer token) |

### Request Body

```json
{
  "order_id": "5O190127TN364715T"
}
```

### Request Validation

| Field | Type | Required | Validation Rules |
|-------|------|----------|------------------|
| `order_id` | string | Yes | PayPal order ID format, must exist in pending transactions |

### Response Format (Success)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "transaction_id": "TXN-123456",
    "amount": 10.00,
    "credits": 10.50,
    "new_balance": 35.50
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `transaction_id` | string | Internal transaction reference |
| `amount` | numeric | Payment amount in USD |
| `credits` | numeric | Credits awarded (base + bonus) |
| `new_balance` | numeric | User's updated credit balance |

### Error Responses

| Status | Condition | Response |
|--------|-----------|----------|
| 400 | Order already captured | `{"success": false, "error": "Order already captured"}` |
| 400 | Order expired (3 hour window) | `{"success": false, "error": "Order expired"}` |
| 401 | Unauthenticated request | `{"success": false, "error": "Unauthenticated"}` |
| 401 | Order belongs to different user | `{"success": false, "error": "Unauthorized"}` |
| 404 | Order not found | `{"success": false, "error": "Order not found"}` |
| 422 | Validation error | `{"success": false, "error": {...}}` |

### Controller Implementation

**PayPalCaptureController@store():**
1. Validates `order_id` via FormRequest
2. Finds pending transaction by `order_id` with `lockForUpdate()`
3. Verifies order ownership (IDOR prevention)
4. Checks order status (must be 'approved')
5. Validates order expiration (3 hour window)
6. Calls `PayPalGatewayService->capturePayment()`
7. Updates Credit balance directly within DB transaction
8. Updates transaction metadata with 'completed' status
9. Returns transaction details with new balance

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Order Ownership Verification | IDOR prevention - only order owner can capture |
| Double Capture Prevention | Status check + `lockForUpdate()` for race conditions |
| Order Expiration | 3 hour capture window enforced |
| Authentication | Bearer token required (Sanctum) |
| Audit Logging | All capture attempts logged |

### Business Logic

**Capture Flow:**
1. Frontend calls TASK-26-13 endpoint to create order
2. PayPal popup handles authentication
3. User approves in popup
4. Frontend calls THIS endpoint (capture)
5. Credits added to user balance

**Transaction States:**
| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `pending` | Order created (TASK-26-13) |
| `approved` | User approved in PayPal popup |
| `completed` | Capture successful, credits added |
| `failed` | Capture failed |
| `cancelled` | User cancelled |

**Credit Balance Update:**
- Direct Credit model update within DB transaction
- Creates Credit record if missing (for new users)
- Updates `balance` and `total_purchased` fields

## Models List API Endpoint (TASK-26-17)

### Endpoint Description
Public REST API endpoint for listing available AI models with pricing information, capabilities, and context window details. Supports filtering by provider, free tier status, and capabilities. Used by the frontend model picker component for the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026).

### Component Location

- **Route:** `backend/routes/api.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/ModelControllerTest.php`

| Method | Endpoint | Authentication |
|--------|----------|----------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/models` | Optional (public) |

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `provider` | string | No | Filter by provider (e.g., 'openrouter') |
| `free_only` | boolean | No | Filter to free tier models only (true/1/false/0) |

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,

      "estimated_cost_per_analysis": 0.05,
      "context_window": 128000,
      "is_free_tier": false,
      "capabilities": ["tools", "vision"],
      "is_user_default": true
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 25,
    "free_tier_count": 5
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Internal model ID |
| `provider` | string | AI provider name (e.g., 'openrouter') |

| `cost_per_1k_input` | numeric | Cost per 1,000 input tokens (USD) |
| `cost_per_1k_output` | numeric | Cost per 1,000 output tokens (USD) |
| `estimated_cost_per_analysis` | numeric | Estimated cost per analysis (USD) |
| `context_window` | integer | Maximum context window size (tokens) |
| `is_free_tier` | boolean | Whether model is in free tier |
| `capabilities` | array | Model capabilities (e.g., 'vision', 'tools') |
| `is_user_default` | boolean \| null | User's default model flag (authenticated users only) |

## User Model Preferences API (TASK-26-19)

### Service Description
REST API endpoints for users to manage their preferred AI models for analyses. Users can set a default model that will be automatically selected when starting a new analysis, with the ability to override per-analysis. Part of the Billing, Credits & Model Selection feature (FEAT-026).

### Component Location
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/ModelController.php`
- **Model:** `backend/app/Models/UserModelPreference.php`
- **Request:** `backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/SetModelPreferenceRequest.php`
- **Migration:** `backend/database/migrations/2026_03_03_100000_create_user_model_preferences_table.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Models/UserModelPreferenceTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Api/V1/UserModelPreferencesTest.php`

### Database Schema

**user_model_preferences table:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE user_model_preferences (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    model_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    is_default TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES ai_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE KEY idx_user_model_unique (user_id, model_id),
    INDEX idx_user_id (user_id),
    INDEX idx_model_id (model_id)
);
```

### API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/api/v1/models/preferences` | List user's saved model preferences |
| POST | `/api/v1/models/preferences` | Set user's default model preference |

### Get User Preferences
`GET /api/v1/models/preferences`

**Authentication Required:** Yes (Sanctum)

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "preferences": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "model_id": 5,
        "is_default": true,
        "model": {
          "id": 5,
          "display_name": "GPT-4 Turbo",
          "provider": "openrouter"
        }
      }
    ],
    "default_model": {
      "id": 5,
      "display_name": "GPT-4 Turbo",
      "provider": "openrouter"
    }
  }
}
```

### Set Model Preference
`POST /api/v1/models/preferences`

**Authentication Required:** Yes (Sanctum)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "model_id": 5,
  "is_default": true
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Model preference updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "default_model": {
      "id": 5,
      "display_name": "GPT-4 Turbo",
      "provider": "openrouter"
    }
  }
}
```

**Validation Rules:**
| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `model_id` | Required, exists in ai_models table, must be active |
| `is_default` | Boolean, optional (default: true) |

**Error Responses:**
| Status | Condition |
|--------|-----------|
| 401 | Unauthenticated request |
| 422 | Invalid model_id or model is not active |

### UserModelPreference Model

**Properties:**
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `id` | bigint | Primary key |
| `user_id` | bigint | FK to users table |
| `model_id` | bigint | FK to ai_models table |
| `is_default` | boolean | Whether this is user's default model |
| `created_at` | timestamp | Record creation time |
| `updated_at` | timestamp | Last update time |

**Relationships:**
| Method | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `user()` | BelongsTo | User who owns this preference |
| `model()` | BelongsTo | AIModel this preference references |

**Scopes:**
| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `forUser($userId)` | Filter preferences by user |
| `default()` | Filter only default preferences |
| `ordered()` | Order by creation date descending |

### Business Logic

| Rule | Implementation |
|------|----------------|
| Single Default | Only one model can be default per user |
| Auto-Unset Previous | Setting new default automatically unsets previous default |
| Active Models Only | Cannot set preference for inactive models |
| User Isolation | Each user has separate preferences |
| Cascade Delete | Preferences removed when user or model is deleted |

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Authentication Required | All endpoints require valid Sanctum token |
| User Isolation | Users can only access their own preferences |
| SQL Injection Protection | Parameterized queries via Eloquent |
| XSS Protection | Laravel response encoding |
| Input Validation | SetModelPreferenceRequest validates all inputs |
| Active Model Check | Model must exist and be active |
| Rate Limiting | Standard API rate limits apply |

### HTTP Method Restrictions

| Method | Status | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| GET | 200 OK | Allowed - list preferences |
| POST | 200 OK | Allowed - set preference |
| PUT | 405 Method Not Allowed | Not allowed |
| DELETE | 405 Method Not Allowed | Not allowed |
| PATCH | 405 Method Not Allowed | Not allowed |

- **Integration:** `frontend/app/seo-guides/[slug]/page.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/components/guides/__tests__/GuideSchema.test.tsx`

### Core Functionalities

**GuideSchema Component:**
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| HowTo Schema | Generates schema.org HowTo structured data |
| Step Generation | Converts guide sections to HowToStep array |
| totalTime | ISO 8601 duration from guide read time (PT{n}M) |
| estimatedCost | Set to free (0 USD) for all guides |
| JSON-LD Output | `<script type="application/ld+json">` injection |

### HowTo Schema Structure

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "HowTo",
  "name": "Guide Title",
  "description": "Guide summary text...",
  "step": [
    {
      "@type": "HowToStep",
      "name": "Section Title",
      "text": "Section content (truncated to 200 chars)..."
    }
  ],
  "estimatedCost": {
    "@type": "MonetaryAmount",
    "currency": "USD",
    "value": "0"
  },
  "totalTime": "PT5M"
}
```

### Component API

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `guide` | `SEOGuide \| null` | Guide data object from registry |

**Exports:**
| Export | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GuideSchema` | Component | React component for schema injection |
| `generateHowToSchema` | Function | Pure function to generate schema object |

**Return Value:**
- Returns `<script type="application/ld+json">` element with schema
- Returns `null` if guide is null or invalid

### Schema.org Compliance

| Property | Required | Implementation |
|----------|----------|----------------|
| `@context` | Yes | `"https://schema.org"` |
| `@type` | Yes | `"HowTo"` |
| `name` | Yes | Guide title |
| `description` | Recommended | Guide summary |
| `step` | Yes | Array of HowToStep |
| `estimatedCost` | Optional | Free (0 USD) |
| `totalTime` | Optional | ISO 8601 duration |

### HowToStep Generation

Each guide section becomes a HowToStep:

| Guide Section | HowToStep Property |
|---------------|-------------------|
| `title` | `name` |
| `content` | `text` (truncated to 200 chars) |

**Step Processing:**
```typescript
sections.map((section, index) => ({
  "@type": "HowToStep",
  "name": section.title,
  "text": section.content.substring(0, 200),
  "position": index + 1
}))
```

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| XSS Prevention | JSON-LD is safe in script tag context (not parsed as HTML) |
| Input Validation | Null guide returns null component |
| Content Sanitization | JSON.stringify handles special characters |

### Common Issues and Solutions

| Issue | Cause | Solution |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Card not showing | Missing `twitter:card` tag | Add `<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />` |
| Image not loading | Non-HTTPS or private URL | Use absolute HTTPS URLs, ensure image is publicly accessible |
| Old preview showing | Twitter cache | Use Card Validator to refresh cache, add query param `?v=2` |
| "No card found" error | Wrong attribute or JS rendering | Use `name` attribute (not `property`), ensure server-side rendering |
| Blurry image | Low resolution source | Use higher resolution source image (1200×628px minimum) |

## ModelSelectionService (TASK-31-8)

### Service Description
Core service for selecting the optimal AI model based on content size, user preferences, and availability. Implements intelligent model selection logic that balances cost optimization (smaller models for smaller content) with context window requirements. Part of the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/ModelSelectionService.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/ModelSelectionServiceTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `selectModel(int $estimatedTokens, ?User $user = null): string` | Choose optimal model for content size |
| `getUserPreference(User $user): ?string` | Get user's preferred model from preferences |
| `getFallbackModel(): string` | Return default fallback model (Gemini 2.0 Flash) |
| `isModelAvailable(string $modelId): bool` | Check if model is active in database |
| `getAvailableModels(): Collection` | Return free-tier models sorted by context window |

### Model Selection Priority

The service follows a priority order for model selection:

| Priority | Condition | Model Selection |
|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| 1 | User has preference + fits context | User's preferred model |
| 2 | Content < 4K tokens | Llama 3 8B (smallest, fastest) |
| 3 | Content < 26K tokens | Qwen 2 / Mistral 7B (medium context) |
| 4 | Default fallback | Gemini 2.0 Flash (large context) |

### Model Priority Matrix

| Content Size | Primary Model | Fallback | Notes |
|--------------|---------------|----------|-------|
| < 4K tokens | Llama 3 8B | Qwen 2 | Fastest, smallest context |
| 4K - 26K tokens | Qwen 2 / Mistral 7B | Gemini 2.0 | Medium context |
| 26K - 900K tokens | Gemini 2.0 Flash | N/A | Large context |
| > 900K tokens | Gemini + Truncation | - | Requires content truncation |

### Effective Context Limits

The service uses safety margins to ensure content fits:

| Model | Raw Context Window | Safety Margin | Effective Limit |
|-------|-------------------|---------------|-----------------|
| Llama 3 8B | 8,192 tokens | 90% - 3,400 overhead | ~3,972 tokens |
| Qwen 2 / Mistral 7B | 32,768 tokens | 90% - 3,400 overhead | ~26,091 tokens |
| Gemini 2.0 Flash | 1,000,000 tokens | 90% - 3,400 overhead | ~896,600 tokens |

### Integration with FEAT-026

The service integrates with the existing billing/model system:

| Integration | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| `UserModelPreference` | Checks user's default model preference |
| `AIModel` | Queries active models from database |
| `ModelPricingService` | Future: credit balance checks for paid models |

### User Preference Handling

```php
public function getUserPreference(User $user): ?string
{
    $cacheKey = "user_preferred_model:{$user->id}";
    
    return Cache::remember($cacheKey, 300, function () use ($user) {
        $preference = UserModelPreference::where('user_id', $user->id)
            ->where('is_default', true)
            ->first();
        
        if (!$preference?->model?->model_id) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify model is still active
        if (!$this->isModelAvailable($preference->model->model_id)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $preference->model->model_id;
    });
}
```

### Selection Algorithm

```php
public function selectModel(int $estimatedTokens, ?User $user = null): string
{
    // 1. Check user preference (if set and fits context)
    if ($user) {
        $preferred = $this->getUserPreference($user);
        if ($preferred && $this->contextManager->fitsInContext($preferred, $estimatedTokens)) {
            return $preferred;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Select smallest sufficient model (cost optimization)
    foreach (self::MODEL_PRIORITY as $model) {
        if ($this->contextManager->fitsInContext($model, $estimatedTokens)) {
            return $model;
        }
    }
    
    // 3. Fallback to largest context model
    return self::DEFAULT_MODEL;
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Cache Key Safety | User ID scoped cache keys |
| SQL Injection Prevention | Eloquent ORM with parameterized queries |
| No Sensitive Data | Only model IDs stored/retrieved |
| Input Validation | Token count validated as positive integer |

| Important | Compress images before uploading (lossy for photos, lossless for graphics) |
| Important | Use responsive images with srcset for different screen sizes |
| Important | Optimize images before upload using tools like Squoosh or TinyPNG |

### Key Technical Details

|-------|---------|
| HTTPS | HTTP over TLS/SSL - encrypted communication between browser and server |
| Ranking Signal | Google has used HTTPS as a ranking signal since 2014 |
| Mobile-First | HTTPS is required for mobile-first indexing |
| Browser Warnings | Chrome shows "Not Secure" for HTTP pages with forms |

### Code Examples

| Example | Language | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Apache HTTPS redirect | Apache/.htaccess | 301 permanent redirect to HTTPS |

### Security Headers Covered

| Header | Purpose | Recommended Value |
|--------|---------|-------------------|
| `Strict-Transport-Security` | Force HTTPS connections | `max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` |
| `X-Frame-Options` | Prevent clickjacking | `SAMEORIGIN` or `DENY` |
| `X-Content-Type-Options` | Prevent MIME sniffing | `nosniff` |
| `Content-Security-Policy` | Control resource sources | Custom policy per site |

### Best Practices Checklist

| Priority | Item |
|----------|------|
| Critical | Install SSL certificate and enable HTTPS |
| Critical | Set up 301 permanent redirects from HTTP to HTTPS |
| Critical | Add HSTS header with includeSubDomains and preload |
| Important | Update all internal links to use HTTPS |
| Important | Fix mixed content warnings (HTTP resources on HTTPS pages) |
| Important | Add X-Frame-Options header set to SAMEORIGIN |
| Important | Add X-Content-Type-Options header set to nosniff |
| Important | Submit domain to HSTS preload list (hstspreload.org) |
| Recommended | Use free SSL from Let's Encrypt with auto-renewal |
| Recommended | Test configuration with SSL Labs SSL Test |

## Mobile-Friendly Checker Tool (TASK-16-7)

### Tool Description
SEO analysis tool that analyzes a page's mobile readiness by checking viewport configuration, responsive design indicators, and providing a mobile preview. Part of the Interactive SEO Tools feature (FEAT-016).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Tools/MobileFriendlyChecker.php`
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Tools/MobileFriendlyController.php`
- **Route:** `POST /api/v1/tools/mobile-friendly`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/Tools/MobileFriendlyCheckerTest.php`

### API Endpoint

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/api/v1/tools/mobile-friendly` | Analyze page for mobile-friendliness |

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com/page"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "mobileScore": 85,
    "viewport": {
      "present": true,
      "content": "width=device-width, initial-scale=1",
      "valid": true
    },
    "responsiveIndicators": {
      "hasMediaQueries": true,
      "hasFlexibleGrid": true,
      "hasFlexibleImages": true
    },
    "readability": {
      "fontSizeMin": 14,
      "fontSizeWarning": false
    },
    "tapTargets": {
      "links": 45,
      "smallTargets": 3,
      "warning": "3 tap targets may be too small for mobile"
    },
    "issues": [
      {
        "severity": "warning",
        "message": "Some tap targets are smaller than 48x48 pixels"
      }
    ],
    "recommendations": [
      "Viewport meta tag is properly configured ✓",
      "Consider increasing font size for better mobile readability"
    ]
  }
}
```

### Mobile Score Calculation

| Factor | Weight | Points |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Viewport tag present | 30% | 0-30 |
| Responsive indicators | 25% | 0-25 |
| Font readability | 20% | 0-20 |
| Tap target sizes | 25% | 0-25 |

### Checks Performed

| Check | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Viewport Meta Tag | Detects presence and validates configuration |
| Responsive Design | Checks for media queries, flexible grids, flexible images |
| Font Readability | Analyzes minimum font size (16px recommended) |
| Tap Targets | Checks link/button sizes (48x48px minimum) |
| Horizontal Scroll | Detects potential horizontal scroll issues |
| Hidden Elements | Excludes `display: none` elements from tap target count |

### Error Handling

- Empty HTML: Returns `success=true` with score 0 and appropriate message
- Hidden elements: Excluded from tap target analysis
- Invalid URLs: Returns error response with message

## Page Speed Optimization Guide (TASK-20-13)

### Guide Description
Comprehensive SEO guide content for the Page Speed indicator, covering Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS, INP), optimization techniques, measurement tools, and best practices for improving page load performance. Part of the SEO Guides Library (FEAT-020).

### Component Location
- **Registry:** `frontend/lib/guides/registry.ts`
- **Slug:** `page-speed`
- **URL:** `https://seoindicator.com/seo-guides/page-speed/`

### Content Sections

| Section | Description | Word Count |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| What is Page Speed? | FCP, LCP, TTI, TBT, Speed Index metrics definition | ~350 |
| Core Web Vitals | LCP (2.5s), FID (100ms), CLS (0.1), INP (200ms) with thresholds | ~400 |
| Why Speed Matters | SEO ranking impact, UX statistics, conversion data | ~300 |
| Optimization Techniques | Caching, CDN, minification, image optimization, JS/CSS, server | ~450 |
| Measurement Tools | PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, GTmetrix, WebPageTest, web.dev | ~250 |
| SEO Best Practices Checklist | 10 actionable items with priority levels | ~150 |

**Total Content:** ~1,900 words
**Read Time:** 7 minutes

### Core Web Vitals Thresholds

| Metric | Good | Needs Improvement | Poor |
|--------|------|-------------------|------|
| LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) | ≤ 2.5s | 2.5s - 4.0s | > 4.0s |
| FID (First Input Delay) | ≤ 100ms | 100ms - 300ms | > 300ms |
| CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) | ≤ 0.1 | 0.1 - 0.25 | > 0.25 |
| INP (Interaction to Next Paint) | ≤ 200ms | 200ms - 500ms | > 500ms |

### Code Examples

| Example | Language | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Resource hints | HTML | preload/prefetch for critical resources |
| Script loading | HTML | defer/async attribute usage |
| Image lazy loading | HTML | Native lazy loading with dimensions |
| Browser caching | Apache | .htaccess caching headers |
| Server compression | Nginx | Gzip/Brotli configuration |
| CDN configuration | Apache | Cache-Control headers for CDN |
| Core Web Vitals thresholds | TypeScript | Reference thresholds object |

### Best Practices Checklist

| Priority | Item |
|----------|------|
| Critical | Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1) |
| Critical | Enable browser caching for static assets |
| Critical | Compress images and use modern formats (WebP, AVIF) |
| Important | Use a Content Delivery Network (CDN) |
| Important | Minify CSS, JavaScript, and HTML |
| Important | Implement lazy loading for images and videos |
| Important | Optimize server response time (TTFB < 600ms) |
| Important | Remove unused CSS and JavaScript |
| Recommended | Use resource hints (preload, prefetch) |
| Recommended | Implement critical CSS for above-the-fold content |

### Related Guides
- `image-optimization` - Image file optimization techniques
- `mobile-friendly` - Mobile performance considerations

## XML Sitemap Guide (TASK-20-21)

### Guide Description
Comprehensive SEO guide content for the XML Sitemap indicator, covering sitemap structure, generation, submission to search engines, and maintenance. Explains XML Sitemaps as a protocol for helping search engines discover and index website pages efficiently. Part of the SEO Guides Library (FEAT-020).

**Total Content:** ~1,800 words
**Read Time:** 5 minutes

### XML Sitemap Structure

| Tag | Required | Description |
|-----|----------|-------------|
| `<urlset>` | Yes | Container for all URLs, xmlns attribute required |
| `<url>` | Yes | Container for each URL entry |
| `<loc>` | Yes | Canonical URL of the page |
| `<lastmod>` | No | Last modification date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `<changefreq>` | No | How frequently page changes (daily, weekly, monthly) |
| `<priority>` | No | Relative priority (0.0 to 1.0) |

### Best Practices Checklist

| Priority | Item |
|----------|------|

| Critical | Include only canonical URLs in sitemap |
| Important | Keep sitemap updated when content changes |
| Important | Reference sitemap in robots.txt |
| Important | Use sitemap index for sites with 50,000+ URLs |
| Recommended | Include lastmod dates for freshness signals |
| Recommended | Use changefreq and priority sparingly (Google may ignore) |

## AI Suggestion Service Structure (TASK-21-1)

### Service Description
Core AI suggestion service architecture with provider interface, response DTOs, and configuration scaffolding. Foundation for all AI-powered SEO suggestion functionality. Supports multiple AI providers (OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway) with fallback capabilities.

### Component Location
- **Interface:** `backend/app/Services/AI/Contracts/AIProviderInterface.php`
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/AISuggestionService.php`
- **DTOs:** `backend/app/Services/AI/DTOs/AIResponse.php`, `SuggestionResult.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/ai.php`
- **Provider:** `backend/app/Providers/AIServiceProvider.php`

### Core Components

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `AIProviderInterface` | Contract for AI providers (generate, isAvailable, getName) |
| `AIResponse` | Immutable DTO for AI responses (success, content, tokens, latency) |
| `SuggestionResult` | Immutable DTO for SEO suggestions (indicator, score, issues, suggestions) |
| `AISuggestionService` | Core service with provider injection and suggestion methods |

### AIProviderInterface Contract

```php
interface AIProviderInterface
{
    public function generate(string $prompt, array $options = []): AIResponse;
    public function isAvailable(): bool;
    public function getName(): string;
}
```

### AIResponse DTO

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `success` | bool | Whether the AI call succeeded |
| `content` | ?string | The generated content (null on error) |
| `tokensUsed` | int | Total tokens consumed |
| `latencyMs` | int | Response latency in milliseconds |
| `errorMessage` | ?string | Error message (null on success) |

**Factory Methods:**
- `AIResponse::success($content, $tokensUsed, $latencyMs)` - Create success response
- `AIResponse::error($errorMessage, $latencyMs)` - Create error response

### SuggestionResult DTO

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `indicator` | string | The SEO indicator being analyzed |
| `score` | int | Score 0-100 for the indicator |
| `issues` | array | List of detected issues |
| `suggestions` | array | Actionable suggestions with type and text |
| `bestPractices` | array | Best practice recommendations |
| `provider` | string | AI provider name |
| `model` | string | Model used for generation |
| `generatedAt` | DateTimeInterface | Timestamp of generation |

### Configuration

```php
// config/ai.php
[
    'default' => env('AI_PROVIDER', 'openrouter'),
    'providers' => [
        'openrouter' => [
            'api_key' => env('OPENROUTER_API_KEY'),
            'base_url' => env('OPENROUTER_BASE_URL', 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'),
            'model' => env('OPENROUTER_MODEL', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct:free'),
            'timeout' => env('AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', 30),
            'max_tokens' => env('AI_MAX_TOKENS', 1000),
        ],
        'vercel' => [
            'api_key' => env('VERCEL_AI_API_KEY'),
            'model' => env('VERCEL_AI_MODEL', 'gpt-4o-mini'),
            'timeout' => env('AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', 30),
            'max_tokens' => env('AI_MAX_TOKENS', 1000),
        ],
    ],
    'fallback' => ['enabled' => env('AI_FALLBACK_ENABLED', true)],
    'cache' => ['ttl_hours' => env('AI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS', 24)],
    'debug' => env('AI_DEBUG', false),
]
```

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Default |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `AI_PROVIDER` | Default AI provider | `openrouter` |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | OpenRouter API key | Required |
| `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model to use | `meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct:free` |
| `AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | Request timeout | `30` |
| `AI_MAX_TOKENS` | Max tokens per request | `1000` |

## Static Fallback Provider (TASK-21-3)

### Service Description
Static, rule-based fallback provider for AI suggestions that generates SEO optimization suggestions without external AI dependencies. Ensures the AI suggestions feature always returns useful results even when AI providers are unavailable, rate-limited, or experiencing outages. Implements `AIProviderInterface` for seamless integration with the AI suggestion pipeline.

### Component Location
- **Provider:** `backend/app/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallbackProvider.php`
- **Service Provider:** `backend/app/Providers/AIServiceProvider.php`
- **Unit Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallbackProviderTest.php`
- **Indicator Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/Providers/StaticFallback/` (10 files)

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `generate($prompt, $options)` | Generate rule-based suggestions based on indicator type |
| `isAvailable()` | Always returns `true` (no external dependencies) |
| `getName()` | Returns 'static_fallback' |

### Supported Indicators (10 Types)

| Indicator | Rules Implemented | Score Range |
|-----------|-------------------|-------------|
| `title` | Length (50-60 chars optimal), keyword presence, duplicate words, all caps, brand-only detection | 0-100 |
| `meta_description` | Length (150-160 chars optimal), CTA detection, keyword presence, title duplication | 0-100 |
| `robots` | Site blocking detection, CSS/JS blocking, admin path exposure, sitemap reference | 0-100 |
| `sitemap` | XML parsing, urlset/sitemapindex detection, lastmod/changefreq/priority validation | 0-100 |
| `headings` | H1 uniqueness, hierarchy validation (H1→H2→H3), empty heading detection, keyword boost | 0-100 |
| `image_alt` | Missing/empty alt detection, keyword presence in alt text | 0-100 |
| `filenames` | Spaces, special chars, generic names, uppercase, missing extension detection | 0-100 |
| `url` | HTTPS check, query parameters, dynamic URLs, underscores, keyword presence | 0-100 |
| `links` | Internal/external balance, broken links, noopener/nofollow, anchor text analysis | 0-100 |
| `404` | Error detection, redirect suggestions, referrer analysis | 0-100 |

### Rule-Based Scoring Example (Title)

```php
private function scoreTitle(string $title, array $context): array
{
    $score = 100;
    $issues = [];
    
    // Length check (optimal: 50-60 characters)
    $length = strlen($title);
    if ($length < 30) {
        $score -= 20;
        $issues[] = "Title is too short ({$length} chars). Aim for 50-60 characters.";
    } elseif ($length > 60) {
        $score -= 15;
        $issues[] = "Title is too long ({$length} chars). Keep under 60 characters.";
    }
    
    // Keyword presence
    $keyword = $context['keyword'] ?? '';
    if ($keyword && stripos($title, $keyword) === false) {
        $score -= 25;
        $issues[] = "Target keyword '{$keyword}' not found in title.";
    }
    
    return [
        'score' => max(0, $score),
        'issues' => $issues,
        'suggestions' => $this->generateTitleSuggestions($title, $context),
    ];
}
```

### Response Format

All responses follow the standard AI provider JSON schema:

```json
{
  "score": 78,
  "issues": [
    "Title is too short (15 chars). Aim for 50-60 characters.",
    "Target keyword 'test' not found in title."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "type": "improve",
      "text": "Test Page Title | Premium Quality Products",
      "reason": "Includes target keyword and value proposition"
    }
  ],
  "best_practices": [
    "Keep title under 60 characters",
    "Place primary keyword near the beginning"
  ]
}
```

### Provider Identification

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| `provider` | `static_fallback` |
| `model` | `rule-based` |
| `tokens` | `0` (no token consumption) |
| `latency` | `< 50ms` (typical) |

## AI Suggestion Caching Layer (TASK-21-6)

### Service Description
Caching layer for AI suggestions that stores responses for identical requests to reduce API calls, costs, and improve response times. Uses SHA-256 hashing for request deduplication with configurable TTL (default 24 hours). Part of the AI Suggestions via OpenRouter/Vercel Gateway feature (FEAT-021).

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/AISuggestionCache.php`
- **Controller:** `backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/AICacheController.php`
- **Command:** `backend/app/Console/Commands/AICacheClear.php`
- **Config:** `backend/config/ai.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/AISuggestionCacheTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Services/AI/AISuggestionCacheIntegrationTest.php`, `backend/tests/Feature/Console/AICacheClearCommandTest.php`

### Core Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|--------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `generateHash()` | indicator, context, provider | string | SHA-256 hash for request deduplication |
| `get()` | hash | ?array | Retrieve cached response or null |
| `set()` | hash, response, ttlHours | void | Store response in cache with TTL |
| `invalidate()` | hash | bool | Remove specific cache entry |
| `invalidateByIndicator()` | indicator | int | Remove all entries for indicator |
| `clear()` | - | int | Clear all cache entries |
| `getStats()` | - | array | Get hit/miss statistics |
| `resetStats()` | - | void | Reset statistics counters |
| `logMetrics()` | - | void | Log cache metrics to file |

### Hash Generation

```php
public function generateHash(string $indicator, array $context, string $provider): string
{
    $data = [
        'indicator' => $indicator,
        'context' => $this->normalizeContext($context),
        'provider' => $provider,
    ];
    return hash('sha256', json_encode($data));
}

private function normalizeContext(array $context): array
{
    ksort($context); // Sort keys for consistent hashing
    return $context;
}
```

### Cache Flow

```
Request → Generate Hash → Check Cache
                           ↓
                    ┌──────┴──────┐
                    ↓             ↓
                   HIT           MISS
                    ↓             ↓
              Return cached   Call AI provider
                    ↓             ↓
                    └─────→ Store in cache ←─────┘
                                  ↓
                          Return response
```

### Admin API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|----------|--------|------|-------------|
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache/stats` | GET | Admin | Get cache statistics |
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache/invalidate` | POST | Admin | Invalidate specific entry |
| `/api/v1/admin/ai/cache` | DELETE | Admin | Clear all cache entries |

**POST /api/v1/admin/ai/cache/invalidate Request:**
```json
{
    "hash": "abc123...64chars"
}
```

**GET /api/v1/admin/ai/cache/stats Response:**
```json
{
    "total_entries": 1250,
    "hits": 8500,
    "misses": 3200,
    "hit_ratio": 0.726,
    "evictions": 45
}
```

### Artisan Command

```bash
php artisan ai:cache:clear [options]

Options:
  --force     Skip confirmation prompt
  --dry-run   Show what would be cleared without deleting
  --stats     Show cache statistics before/after clearing
```

### Configuration

| Environment Variable | Default | Description |
|---------------------|---------|-------------|
| `AI_CACHE_ENABLED` | `true` | Enable/disable caching |
| `AI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS` | `24` | Cache time-to-live in hours |
| `CACHE_DRIVER` | `file` | Laravel cache driver |

**config/ai.php:**
```php
'cache' => [
    'enabled' => env('AI_CACHE_ENABLED', true),
    'ttl_hours' => env('AI_CACHE_TTL_HOURS', 24),
],
```

### Performance Characteristics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Hash generation | < 5ms |
| Cache get | < 1ms |
| Cache set | < 2ms |
| Cache hit response time | < 10ms (vs 1-5s AI generation) |
| Expected hit rate | 60-80% for common indicators |
| Storage | File-based (`storage/framework/cache/data/`) |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Admin-only endpoints | Sanctum authentication with admin role |
| Input validation | Hash must be 64-character hexadecimal |
| Cache key isolation | Prefix `ai_suggestions:` prevents collision |
| No sensitive data | Only stores AI suggestions (non-PII) |

| `logError(string $indicator, string $error, array $context = []): void` | indicator type, error message, optional context | Log AI errors with sanitized context |
| `logDebug(string $message, array $data = []): void` | debug message, optional data | Log debug information when debug mode enabled |

### Debug Mode Implementation

**Activation Requirements:**
| Requirement | Implementation |
|-------------|----------------|
| Environment Variable | `AI_DEBUG=true` in `.env` |
| Authentication | User must be authenticated (Sanctum) |
| Both Required | Debug mode only active when BOTH conditions met |

**Debug Response Structure:**
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "data": { /* suggestions */ },
    "debug": {
        "prompt": "Full prompt text sent to AI...",
        "raw_response": "Raw JSON from provider...",
        "tokens_used": 245,
        "latency_ms": 1250,
        "provider": "openrouter",
        "model": "llama-3.1-8b-instruct"
    }
}
```

**Security Constraints:**
| Constraint | Implementation |
|------------|----------------|
| No API keys in debug | Keys masked as `***REDACTED***` |
| No PII in debug | User data excluded from debug output |
| Auth required | Unauthenticated requests never get debug info |
| Production safe | Debug mode disabled by default |

### Privacy Protection

**Sensitive Key Masking:**
The AILogger automatically masks sensitive keys in logged data:
| Key Pattern | Masked Value |
|-------------|--------------|
| `api_key`, `apikey` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `password`, `passwd` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `token`, `secret` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `authorization` | `***REDACTED***` |
| `private_key` | `***REDACTED***` |

**PII Exclusion:**
The following fields are excluded from logs entirely:
| Excluded Field | Reason |
|----------------|--------|
| `user_email` | Personal identifier |
| `user_name` | Personal identifier |
| `user_id` | Personal identifier |
| `ip_address` | Personal identifier |

**URL Anonymization:**
URLs are anonymized in logs by hashing the path/query:
```
Original: https://example.com/users/123/profile?token=abc
Logged:   https://example.com/[anon:a1b2c3d4e5f6...]
```

### Log Channel Configuration

**Logging Channel:**
```php
// config/logging.php
'channels' => [
    'ai' => [
        'driver' => 'daily',
        'path' => storage_path('logs/ai.log'),
        'level' => 'debug',
        'days' => 30,
    ],
],
```

**Log Retention:**
| Setting | Value | Purpose |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Driver | `daily` | Automatic rotation |
| Retention | 30 days | Reasonable debug window |
| Level | `debug` | Capture all log levels |

### Request Hash Generation

Each AI request is assigned a unique SHA-256 hash for correlation:
```php
$hash = hash('sha256', $indicator . json_encode($context) . time());
```

**Hash Usage:**
- Correlate request/response logs
- Track request lifecycle
- Debug timing issues
- Identify duplicate requests

**Request Log:**

    "level": "INFO",
    "message": "AI suggestion request",
    "context": {

        "provider": "openrouter",

        "timestamp": "2026-03-05T13:43:00Z"

}

## ContextWindowManager Service (TASK-31-2)

### Service Description
Core AI context window management service that estimates token counts, validates content against model context limits, and selects optimal AI models based on content size. Foundation service for the Unified AI Prompt + Context Management feature (FEAT-031), enabling intelligent model selection and prompt size validation.

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/AI/ContextWindowManager.php`
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/Unit/Services/AI/ContextWindowManagerTest.php`

### Core Functionalities

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `estimateTokens(string $content): int` | Estimate token count from content using character-based approximation |
| `fitsInContext(string $model, int $estimatedTokens): bool` | Check if content fits within model's effective context limit |
| `selectOptimalModel(int $estimatedTokens): string` | Choose the smallest sufficient model for content size |
| `getEffectiveLimit(string $model): int` | Return effective context limit after safety margin and overhead |
| `getModelLimits(): array` | Return all supported model context limits |

### Model Context Limits

| Model | Context Window | Effective Limit |
|-------|----------------|-----------------|
| `google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free` | 1,000,000 | ~996,600 tokens |
| `qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free` | 32,768 | ~28,600 tokens |
| `mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free` | 32,768 | ~28,600 tokens |
| `meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free` | 8,192 | ~4,600 tokens |

### Implementation Details

**Constants:**
```php
private const MODEL_LIMITS = [
    'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free' => 1000000,
    'qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free' => 32768,
    'mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free' => 32768,
    'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free' => 8192,
];

private const SAFETY_MARGIN = 0.10;      // 10% safety margin
private const BASE_PROMPT_OVERHEAD = 3400; // System prompt + schema
```

**Token Estimation:**
```php
public function estimateTokens(string $content): int
{
    // Character-based estimation: 1 token ≈ 4 characters
    return (int) ceil(strlen($content) / 4);
}
```

**Effective Limit Calculation:**
```php
public function getEffectiveLimit(string $model): int
{
    $limit = self::MODEL_LIMITS[$model] ?? 8192;
    return (int) ($limit * (1 - self::SAFETY_MARGIN)) - self::BASE_PROMPT_OVERHEAD;
}
```

**Model Selection Logic:**
```php
public function selectOptimalModel(int $estimatedTokens): string
{
    // Model priority: smallest sufficient first (Llama → Qwen → Mistral → Gemini)
    $models = [
        'meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free',
        'qwen/qwen-2-7b-instruct:free',
        'mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free',
        'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free',
    ];
    
    foreach ($models as $model) {
        if ($this->fitsInContext($model, $estimatedTokens)) {
            return $model;
        }
    }
    
    // Fallback: will need truncation
    return 'google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free';
}
```

### Effective Limit Formula

```
effectiveLimit = (rawLimit × 0.9) - 3400
```

**Example Calculations:**
| Model | Raw Limit | After Safety (90%) | After Overhead | Effective |
|-------|-----------|-------------------|----------------|-----------|
| Gemini 2.0 Flash | 1,000,000 | 900,000 | 896,600 | ~996,600 |
| Qwen 2 7B | 32,768 | 29,491 | 26,091 | ~28,600 |
| Mistral 7B | 32,768 | 29,491 | 26,091 | ~28,600 |
| Llama 3 8B | 8,192 | 7,373 | 3,973 | ~4,600 |

### Model Selection Priority

The service selects the **smallest sufficient model** to optimize for:
1. **Cost efficiency** - Smaller models are faster and cheaper
2. **Resource optimization** - Reserve larger context for content that needs it
3. **Graceful fallback** - Always returns a model (Gemini for oversized content)

**Selection Order:**
1. Llama 3 8B (~4,600 tokens effective) - For small content
2. Qwen 2 7B (~28,600 tokens effective) - For medium content
3. Mistral 7B (~28,600 tokens effective) - Alternative medium
4. Gemini 2.0 Flash (~996,600 tokens effective) - For large content / fallback

## Rate Limiting for Analysis Jobs (TASK-19-14)

### Service Description
Comprehensive rate limiting system for analysis job creation and API endpoints. Implements multiple rate limit tiers to prevent abuse while allowing legitimate usage, with Redis-backed distributed rate limiting for multi-instance deployments.

### Component Location
- **Service:** `backend/app/Services/Analysis/AnalysisRateLimiterService.php`
- **Middleware:** `backend/app/Http/Middleware/PollingRateLimiter.php`
- **Config:** `bootstrap/app.php` (middleware alias: `polling.ratelimit`)

### Core Functionalities

**AnalysisRateLimiterService Class:**
| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool` | Check if user can create a new job |
| `canMakeApiRequest(User $user): bool` | Check API rate limit (60/min) |
| `canPollJob(User $user, AnalysisJob $job): bool` | Check polling rate limit (30/min/job) |
| `recordJobCreation(User $user, Site $site): void` | Record job creation for rate limiting |
| `recordApiRequest(User $user): void` | Record API request |
| `recordPollRequest(User $user, AnalysisJob $job): void` | Record polling request |
| `getRateLimitHeaders(string $key, int $limit): array` | Generate rate limit headers |
| `buildRateLimitResponse(string $message, int $retryAfter): JsonResponse` | Build 429 response |

### Rate Limit Tiers

| Limit Type | Value | Scope | Purpose |
|------------|-------|-------|---------|
| Jobs per user per hour | 10 | Per user | Prevent job flooding |
| Jobs per site per hour | 5 | Per site | Site-level protection |
| Concurrent jobs per user | 2 | Per user | Resource management |
| API requests per minute | 60 | Per user | General API protection |
| Polling requests per minute | 30 | Per job | Prevent polling abuse |

### Sliding Window Algorithm

Rate limiting uses a sliding window via Laravel Cache (Redis-backed):

```php
class AnalysisRateLimiterService
{
    private const JOB_LIMITS = [
        'user_hourly' => 10,
        'site_hourly' => 5,
        'user_concurrent' => 2,
    ];
    
    private const API_LIMITS = [
        'requests_per_minute' => 60,
        'polling_per_minute' => 30,
    ];
    
    public function canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool
    {
        // Check all three limits
        return $this->checkUserHourlyLimit($user)
            && $this->checkSiteHourlyLimit($site)
            && $this->checkConcurrentLimit($user);
    }
}
```

### Rate Limit Headers

All rate-limited responses include standard headers:

```http
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 45
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1709049600
```

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests allowed in window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests remaining in current window |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when window resets |

### 429 Response Format

When rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.",
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

**Response Headers:**
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 30
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1709049600
```

### Admin Bypass

Admin users can bypass rate limits for testing and debugging:

```php
public function canCreateJob(User $user, Site $site): bool
{
    // Admin bypass
    if ($user->is_admin ?? false) {
        return true;
    }
    
    return $this->enforceLimits($user, $site);
}
```

### PollingRateLimiter Middleware

Dedicated middleware for polling endpoint rate limiting:

```php
class PollingRateLimiter
{
    public function handle($request, Closure $next)
    {
        $job = $request->route('job');
        $user = $request->user();
        
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->canPollJob($user, $job)) {
            return $this->rateLimiter->buildRateLimitResponse(
                'Polling rate limit exceeded',
                $this->rateLimiter->getRetryAfter($user, $job)
            );
        }
        
        $this->rateLimiter->recordPollRequest($user, $job);
        
        $response = $next($request);
        
        // Add rate limit headers
        foreach ($this->rateLimiter->getRateLimitHeaders($user, $job) as $name => $value) {
            $response->header($name, $value);
        }
        
        return $response;
    }
}
```

### Redis Configuration

Rate limiting uses Laravel Cache with Redis driver for distributed systems:

```php
// config/cache.php
'default' => env('CACHE_STORE', 'redis'),

'stores' => [
    'redis' => [
        'driver' => 'redis',
        'connection' => 'cache',
        'lock_connection' => 'default',
    ],
],
```

**Key Patterns:**
| Key Pattern | TTL | Purpose |
|-------------|-----|---------|
| `rate_limit:user:{id}:hourly` | 3600s | User hourly job limit |
| `rate_limit:site:{id}:hourly` | 3600s | Site hourly job limit |
| `rate_limit:user:{id}:concurrent` | - | Concurrent job count |
| `rate_limit:api:{id}:minute` | 60s | API rate limit |
| `rate_limit:poll:{job_id}:minute` | 60s | Polling rate limit |

### SPEC-006 Compatibility

Rate limit responses follow the existing SPEC-006 format:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Retry after 30 seconds.",
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Per-User Isolation | Each user has separate rate limit tracking |
| Per-Job Isolation | Polling limits scoped to individual jobs |
| Timing Attack Prevention | Consistent response times |
| Admin Bypass | Admin users skip rate limits |
| Distributed Support | Redis-backed for multi-instance |

## ExportResultsButton Component (TASK-29-6)

### Component Description
React component that triggers export functionality from tool results view. Displays a button with download icon that opens ExportModal for format selection (PDF/XLS). Part of the Export Results (PDF/XLS) feature (FEAT-029).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/tools/ExportResultsButton.tsx`
- **Integration:** Tool result components (e.g., KeywordDensityResults)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/tools/ExportResultsButton.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-29-6.md`

### Core Functionalities

**ExportResultsButton Component:**
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Export Button | Button with download icon + "Export Results" text |
| Modal Trigger | Opens ExportModal for format selection |
| Disabled State | Disabled when no results available |
| Loading State | Shows spinner when export is generating |
| Accessibility | Dynamic aria-label based on state |

### Component Interface

```typescript
interface ExportResultsButtonProps {
  toolName: string;        // Tool identifier (e.g., 'keyword-density')
  url: string;             // Analyzed URL
  data: Record<string, unknown>;  // Analysis results
  className?: string;      // Optional styling
  isGenerating?: boolean;  // Loading state during export
}
```

### State Management

| State | Condition | Behavior |
|-------|-----------|----------|
| `isModalOpen` | boolean | Controls ExportModal visibility |
| `hasResults` | `data && Object.keys(data).length > 0` | Determines if export is available |
| `disabled` | `!hasResults \|\| isGenerating` | Prevents action without data |

### Disabled State Logic

```typescript
const hasResults = data && Object.keys(data).length > 0;
const isDisabled = !hasResults || isGenerating;
```

| Condition | hasResults | isGenerating | Disabled |
|-----------|------------|--------------|----------|
| Empty data | false | false | ✓ Yes |
| Null data | false | false | ✓ Yes |
| Valid data | true | false | ✗ No |
| Generating | true | true | ✓ Yes |

### Loading State (isGenerating)

When `isGenerating=true`:
- Button shows spinner animation
- Text changes to "Generating..."
- Button remains disabled
- aria-label updates to "Generating export..."

### Accessibility Implementation

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| aria-label | Dynamic based on state |
| Keyboard Navigation | Enter and Space keys supported |
| Focus Management | Focus trap in modal |
| Screen Reader | State changes announced |

**aria-label Values:**
| State | aria-label |
|-------|-----------|
| Default | "Export analysis results" |
| Disabled (no data) | "No results to export" |
| Loading | "Generating export..." |

### Styling

- Uses shadcn Button component with default variant
- Tailwind CSS for responsive design
- Hover and focus states via CSS
- Download icon from lucide-react

### Integration Points

**With ExportModal:**
```tsx
<ExportResultsButton
  toolName="keyword-density"
  url="https://example.com"
  data={analysisResults}
  isGenerating={isExporting}
/>
```

**In Tool Results Components:**
```tsx

<div className="flex justify-end">
  <ExportResultsButton
    toolName="keyword-density"
    url={url}
    data={results}
  />
</div>
```

## Tool Page Integration (TASK-29-8)

### Description
Integration of ExportResultsButton component into 4 SEO tool result pages, enabling users to export analysis results as PDF or XLS files. Part of the Export Results (PDF/XLS) feature (FEAT-029).

### Integration Points

| Tool | Component File | Lines | Tool Name Identifier |
|------|---------------|-------|---------------------|
| Meta Tag Analyzer | `ToolWidget.tsx` | 227-235 | `meta-tag-analyzer` |
| Keyword Density Checker | `ToolWidget.tsx` | 377-385 | `keyword-density-checker` |
| Mobile-Friendly Checker | `MobileFriendlyResults.tsx` | 144-168 | `mobile-friendly-checker` |
| Social Media Preview | `SocialMediaPreviewResults.tsx` | 109-143 | `social-media-preview` |

### Integration Pattern

Each tool result page integrates ExportResultsButton using a consistent pattern:

```tsx
{analysisComplete && (
  <div className="flex justify-end mb-4">
    <ExportResultsButton
      toolName="meta-tag-analyzer"
      url={analyzedUrl}
      data={resultsData}
    />
  </div>
)}
```

### Data Structure (ToolResultData)

```typescript
interface ToolResultData {
  analyzedAt: string;  // ISO timestamp
  results: {
    [indicatorName: string]: {
      value: string | number | boolean;
      status: 'ok' | 'warning' | 'error';
      recommendation?: string;
    };
  };
  summary?: {
    score?: number;
    passed: number;
    warnings: number;
    failed: number;
  };
}
```

### Data Mapping by Tool

**Meta Tag Analyzer:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    title: { value: result.title, status: titleStatus },
    description: { value: result.description, status: descStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passCount, warningCount, failCount },
};
```

**Keyword Density Checker:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    density: { value: density.toFixed(2), status: densityStatus },
    occurrences: { value: occurrences, status: 'ok' },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed: passCount, warnings: warnCount, failed: failCount },
};
```

**Mobile-Friendly Checker:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    viewport: { value: viewportContent, status: viewportStatus },
    responsive: { value: hasResponsiveGrid, status: responsiveStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed, warnings, failed },
};
```

**Social Media Preview:**
```tsx
const exportData = {
  analyzedAt: result.analyzedAt,
  results: {
    openGraph: { value: ogTitle, status: ogStatus },
    twitterCard: { value: cardType, status: twitterStatus },
    // ... additional indicators
  },
  summary: { score, passed, warnings, failed },
};
```

| Disabled State | No data or during generation |

## Mobile Navigation Sheet Component (TASK-28-13)

### Component Description
Responsive mobile navigation component implementing a slide-in Sheet drawer with hamburger menu trigger. Provides touch-friendly navigation for authenticated users on mobile devices (< 768px breakpoint). Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/layout/MobileNav.tsx`
- **Integration:** `frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/layout/MobileNav.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TASK-28-13.md`

### Core Functionalities

**MobileNav Component:**
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Hamburger Menu | Toggle button visible on mobile only (`md:hidden` class) |
| Sheet Drawer | Slides in from left side with animation |
| Navigation Items | Full navigation menu with icons and labels |
| Active State | Visual indicator for current route |
| Touch Targets | Minimum 44px height for accessibility |
| Route Change | Auto-closes on navigation |
| Escape Key | Closes sheet on Escape press |
| Backdrop Click | Closes sheet when clicking outside |

### Component Interface

```typescript
interface NavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  icon?: string;      // Lucide icon name
  badge?: string | number; // Optional badge (notification count)
}

interface UserInfo {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  avatar?: string;
}

interface MobileNavProps {
  navItems: NavItem[];
  currentPath: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  user?: UserInfo | null;
  side?: 'left' | 'right';
}
```

### Responsive Behavior

| Breakpoint | Behavior |
|------------|----------|
| < 768px (md) | Hamburger menu visible, Sheet drawer functional |
| >= 768px | Hamburger menu hidden (`md:hidden`), desktop nav shown |

### Navigation Items Configuration

```typescript
const navItems: NavItem[] = [
  { label: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard', icon: 'LayoutDashboard' },
  { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects', icon: 'FolderKanban' },
  { label: 'Keywords', href: '/keywords', icon: 'Key' },
  { label: 'Reports', href: '/reports', icon: 'FileBarChart' },
  { label: 'Settings', href: '/settings', icon: 'Settings' },
];
```

### Accessibility Implementation

| ARIA Attribute | Value | Purpose |
|----------------|-------|---------|
| `aria-label` (hamburger) | "Open navigation menu" | Screen reader announcement |
| `aria-expanded` | true/false | State indication |
| `role` (sheet) | "dialog" | Dialog semantics |
| `aria-modal` | "true" | Focus trap indication |
| `aria-label` (sheet) | "Navigation menu" | Sheet purpose |

**WCAG 2.1 Compliance:**
- Touch targets minimum 44x44px (Success Criterion 2.5.5)
- Focus trap when sheet is open
- Focus returns to hamburger on close
- Keyboard navigation support (Tab, Escape)
- Screen reader state announcements

### Close Triggers

| Trigger | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Route change | `useEffect` on `pathname` from `usePathname()` |
| Backdrop click | Handled by shadcn Sheet component |
| Escape key | Native Sheet behavior |
| Nav item click | Calls `onOpenChange(false)` |

### Active State Styling

| State | Styling |
|-------|---------|
| Active nav item | Blue indicator bar, highlighted background |
| Inactive nav item | Default styling, hover effects |

### Integration with Header

The MobileNav component integrates with `Header.tsx`:

```typescript
// Header.tsx integration
<header>
  {/* Desktop navigation - visible on md+ */}
  <nav className="hidden md:flex">
    {/* Desktop nav items */}
  </nav>

  {/* Mobile navigation - visible below md */}
  <MobileNav
    navItems={navItems}
    currentPath={pathname}
    isOpen={mobileNavOpen}
    onOpenChange={setMobileNavOpen}
    user={user}
    className="md:hidden"
  />
</header>
```

## ToolEmbed Component for Guide-Tool Integration (TASK-20-22)

### Service Description
Frontend component for embedding interactive SEO tools from FEAT-016 into SEO guide pages. Provides a seamless user experience where users can test their meta tags, check mobile-friendliness, or preview social media shares directly within the educational guide context. Part of the SEO Guides Library + Clean Routing feature (FEAT-020).

### Component Location
- **File:** `frontend/components/guides/ToolEmbed.tsx`
- **Export:** `frontend/components/guides/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/guides/ToolEmbed.test.tsx`

### Component Architecture

```
ToolEmbed (main export)
├── ToolEmbedInner (wrapped in ErrorBoundary)
│   ├── LoadingSkeleton (lazy loading state)
│   ├── FallbackUI (invalid tool slug)
│   └── ToolWidget (actual tool rendering)
└── ErrorFallback (error boundary UI)
```

### Supported Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `toolSlug` | `ToolSlug \| string` | **required** | Tool to embed |
| `title` | `string` | tool name | Custom title override |
| `description` | `string` | tool description | Custom description override |
| `showCta` | `boolean` | `true` | Show "Use Full Tool" CTA button |
| `ctaText` | `string` | `"Use Full Tool"` | CTA button text |
| `className` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable lazy loading |
| `stateKey` | `string` | - | State persistence key |
| `onAnalysisComplete` | `(result) => void` | - | Analysis callback |

### Valid Tool Slugs

| toolSlug | Tool Page Route | Description |
|----------|-----------------|-------------|
| `meta-tag-analyzer` | `/tools/meta-tag-analyzer/` | Meta title and description analyzer |
| `keyword-density` | `/tools/keyword-density/` | Keyword frequency analysis |
| `social-preview` | `/tools/social-preview/` | Open Graph and Twitter Card preview |
| `mobile-friendly-checker` | `/tools/mobile-friendly/` | Mobile responsiveness checker |

### Core Features

**Graceful Fallback:**
- Invalid or missing `toolSlug` displays friendly message
- CTA button directs users to tools index page
- Error boundary catches and displays tool errors

**Mobile Responsiveness:**
- Responsive wrapper adapts to container width
- CTA button styled for touch targets
- Full-width tool widget on mobile

**Security:**
- XSS prevention for all text inputs
- `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on external links
- Sanitized tool slug validation

**Accessibility:**
- Proper ARIA attributes on interactive elements
- Screen reader support for tool status
- Keyboard accessible CTA button

**Performance:**
- Lazy loading via Next.js `dynamic()` import
- Loading skeleton during tool load
- Error boundary prevents full page crashes

### TypeScript Types

```typescript
type ToolSlug = 'meta-tag-analyzer' | 'keyword-density' | 'social-preview' | 'mobile-friendly-checker';

interface ToolEmbedProps {
  toolSlug: ToolSlug | string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  showCta?: boolean;
  ctaText?: string;
  className?: string;
  lazy?: boolean;
  stateKey?: string;
  onAnalysisComplete?: (result: AnalysisResult) => void;
}
```

### Usage Examples

**Basic Tool Embed:**
```tsx
import { ToolEmbed } from '@/components/guides';

export default function MetaTitleGuide() {
  return (
    <GuideLayout>
      <GuideContent guide={guide} />
      <ToolEmbed toolSlug="meta-tag-analyzer" />
    </GuideLayout>
  );
}
```

**Custom Title and CTA:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="social-preview"
  title="Preview Your Social Shares"
  ctaText="Open Full Preview Tool"
/>
```

**With State Persistence:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="meta-tag-analyzer"
  stateKey="guide-meta-title-demo"
  onAnalysisComplete={(result) => console.log('Analysis:', result)}
/>
```

**Disable Lazy Loading:**
```tsx
<ToolEmbed
  toolSlug="keyword-density"
  lazy={false}
/>
```

### Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Invalid `toolSlug` | Fallback UI with CTA to tools index |
| Tool crashes | Error boundary catches, shows error fallback |
| Tool unavailable | Loading skeleton → fallback UI |
