## Skeleton Loader Variants (TASK-28-9)

### Component Description
Specialized skeleton loader components for different content types: cards, tables, charts, and the indicator catalog. Provides visual placeholders during data loading with pulse animations for improved perceived performance. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **CardSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/CardSkeleton.tsx`
- **TableSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/TableSkeleton.tsx`
- **ChartSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/ChartSkeleton.tsx`
- **IndicatorCatalogSkeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/IndicatorCatalogSkeleton.tsx`
- **Barrel Export:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/index.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/ui/skeletons/SkeletonLoaders.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-28-9.md`

### Core Functionalities

**Skeleton Components:**
| Component | Purpose | Key Props |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| `CardSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for indicator cards | `showIcon`, `lines`, `className` |
| `TableSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for data tables | `rows`, `columns`, `showHeader`, `className` |
| `ChartSkeleton` | Loading placeholder for charts | `type` ('line' | 'bar' | 'pie'), `className` |
| `IndicatorCatalogSkeleton` | Full catalog loading state | `count`, `columns`, `className` |

### CardSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface CardSkeletonProps {
  showIcon?: boolean;    // Default: true
  lines?: number;        // Default: 3
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Configurable icon placeholder (default: visible)
- Variable line count (default: 3)
- Varying line widths for visual interest (75%, 100%, 50%)
- Dark mode support with `dark:` classes
- Accessibility: `aria-busy="true"`, `aria-label="Loading content"`

### TableSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface TableSkeletonProps {
  rows?: number;         // Default: 5
  columns?: number;      // Default: 4
  showHeader?: boolean;  // Default: true
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Semantic HTML structure (`<table>`, `<thead>`, `<tbody>`)
- Configurable row/column counts
- Toggle header row visibility
- Hover effects and striped rows styling
- Responsive column handling

### ChartSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface ChartSkeletonProps {
  type?: 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';  // Default: 'line'
  className?: string;
}
``

**Chart Type Visualizations:**
| Type | Visual Placeholder |
|------|-------------------|
| `line` | SVG path with data points, axis placeholders, grid lines |
| `bar` | Vertical bars with varying heights, axis placeholders |
| `pie` | Circular segments with legend placeholders |

**Features:**
- Unique visual for each chart type
- Axis and grid line placeholders for data charts
- Legend area for pie charts
- Dark mode compatible

### IndicatorCatalogSkeleton Component

**Props Interface:**
``typescript
interface ResponsiveColumns {
  default?: number;  // Default: 1
  sm?: number;       // Small screens
  md?: number;       // Medium screens
  lg?: number;       // Large screens
  xl?: number;       // Extra large screens
  '2xl'?: number;    // 2X large screens
}

interface IndicatorCatalogSkeletonProps {
  count?: number;           // Number of card skeletons, default: 6
  columns?: ResponsiveColumns;
  className?: string;
}
``

**Features:**
- Configurable count of card skeletons
- Responsive grid layout with breakpoint support
- Header and search/filter skeleton areas
- Uses CardSkeleton components internally
- Responsive columns: default(1), sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl breakpoints

### Pulse Animation

All skeleton components use the `animate-pulse` Tailwind CSS class for consistent loading animation:

``css
.animate-pulse {
  animation: pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}
``

### Accessibility Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| ARIA Busy State | `aria-busy="true"` on all skeleton containers |
| ARIA Labels | `aria-label="Loading..."` for screen readers |
| Semantic Structure | Proper HTML elements (table, thead, tbody) |
| Reduced Motion | Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` media query |

### Security Implementation

| Measure | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| No User Input | Components render static placeholder content only |
| XSS Prevention | No dynamic content rendering |
| No Sensitive Data | No data exposure risk |

## Loading State Integration (TASK-28-11)

### Component Description
Comprehensive loading state system integrating skeleton loaders, progress indicators, and optimistic update patterns throughout the application. Provides unified loading UX with error boundaries, empty states, and retry functionality. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Locations
- **useLoadingState Hook:** `frontend/lib/hooks/useLoadingState.ts`
- **useOptimisticUpdate Hook:** `frontend/lib/hooks/useOptimisticUpdate.ts`
- **Hooks Index:** `frontend/lib/hooks/index.ts`
- **LoadingContext:** `frontend/lib/contexts/LoadingContext.tsx`
- **ErrorBoundary:** `frontend/components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx`
- **EmptyState:** `frontend/components/ui/EmptyState.tsx`
- **LoadingWrapper:** `frontend/components/ui/LoadingWrapper.tsx`
- **ButtonLoading:** `frontend/components/ui/ButtonLoading.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/integration/loading-state-integration.test.tsx` (54 tests)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/integration/loading-state-actual-components.test.tsx` (44 tests)
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-28-11.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `useLoadingState` | Hook for managing loading state with retry logic |
| `useOptimisticUpdate` | Hook for optimistic updates with rollback |
| `LoadingContext` | Context provider for global loading state |
| `ErrorBoundary` | Error catching with retry functionality |
| `EmptyState` | Helpful messaging when no data available |
| `LoadingWrapper` | Unified loading/error/empty state wrapper |
| `ButtonLoading` | Button with CircularProgress integration |

### useLoadingState Hook

**Interface:**
```typescript
interface UseLoadingStateOptions {
  initialLoading?: boolean;
  maxRetries?: number;
}

interface UseLoadingStateReturn {
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  retryCount: number;
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
  setError: (error: Error | null) => void;
  retry: () => void;
  reset: () => void;
}
```

**Features:**
- Configurable initial loading state
- Maximum retry count tracking
- Error state management
- Reset functionality for clean state

### useOptimisticUpdate Hook

**Interface:**
```typescript
interface UseOptimisticUpdateOptions<T> {
  data: T;
  onUpdate: (newData: T) => Promise<void>;
}

interface UseOptimisticUpdateReturn<T> {
  optimisticData: T;
  isPending: boolean;
  update: (newData: T) => Promise<void>;
  rollback: () => void;
}
```

**Features:**
- Shows expected result before API response
- Automatic rollback on API failure
- Confirms state on API success
- Tracks pending state during operation

### ErrorBoundary Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  fallback?: React.ReactNode;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  maxRetries?: number;
}
```

**Features:**
- Class component for error catching (React requirement)
- Retry functionality with count tracking
- Custom fallback support
- ARIA-compliant error display

**Error Display:**
- Clear error message with icon
- Retry button with attempt count
- Graceful degradation UI

### EmptyState Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface EmptyStateProps {
  type?: 'keywords' | 'competitors' | 'reports' | 'analyses' | 'projects' | 'default';
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  ctaText?: string;
  onCtaClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Pre-defined Types:**
| Type | Title | Description | CTA |
|------|-------|-------------|-----|
| `keywords` | No keywords yet | Start tracking your first keyword | Add Keyword |
| `competitors` | No competitors configured | Add competitors to track | Add Competitor |
| `reports` | No reports generated | Create your first report | Create Report |
| `analyses` | No analyses yet | Run your first SEO analysis | Start Analysis |
| `projects` | No projects created | Create your first project | Create Project |
| `default` | No data available | Get started by adding items | Get Started |

### LoadingWrapper Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface LoadingWrapperProps {
  isLoading: boolean;
  error?: Error | null;
  isEmpty?: boolean;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  skeleton?: React.ReactNode;
  emptyState?: EmptyStateProps;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  showLinearProgress?: boolean;
  progress?: number;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Features:**
- Unified loading state wrapper
- Shows skeleton during loading
- Shows error with retry option
- Shows empty state when no data
- Optional LinearProgress integration
- Determinate progress support (0-100)

### ButtonLoading Component

**Props:**
```typescript
interface ButtonLoadingProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  loadingText?: string;
  progress?: number;
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'link';
  size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon';
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Features:**
- CircularProgress integration for buttons
- Loading text support (replaces children during loading)
- Determinate progress support (0-100)
- Multiple variants and sizes
- Automatic disable during loading

### Loading UX Patterns

| Pattern | Implementation | Use Case |
|---------|---------------|----------|
| **Optimistic Updates** | useOptimisticUpdate hook | Keyword status changes, project updates |

## Indicator Catalog Component (TASK-28-10)

### Component Description
Interactive grid component displaying all 17 SEO indicators on the homepage. Provides visual representation of indicator status, scores, and quick access to detailed analysis. Features responsive layout, category filtering, and real-time score updates. Part of the Modern UI/UX + Indicator Catalog feature (FEAT-028).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCatalog.tsx`
- **Card Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorCard.tsx`
- **Grid Component:** `frontend/components/indicators/IndicatorGrid.tsx`
- **Types:** `frontend/lib/types/indicator.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/indicators/IndicatorCatalog.test.tsx`
- **Skeleton:** `frontend/components/ui/skeletons/IndicatorCatalogSkeleton.tsx`

### Component Props

```typescript
interface IndicatorCatalogProps {
  indicators?: Indicator[];           // Pre-loaded indicator data
  showFilters?: boolean;              // Show category filter tabs (default: true)
  showSearch?: boolean;               // Show search input (default: true)
  columns?: ResponsiveColumns;        // Responsive column configuration
  className?: string;
}

interface ResponsiveColumns {
  default?: number;  // Default: 1
  sm?: number;       // 640px breakpoint
  md?: number;       // 768px breakpoint
  lg?: number;       // 1024px breakpoint
  xl?: number;       // 1280px breakpoint
  '2xl'?: number;    // 1536px breakpoint
}
```

### Indicator Data Structure

```typescript
interface Indicator {
  id: string;                        // Unique identifier (e.g., 'keyword-rankings')
  slug: string;                      // URL-friendly identifier
  title: string;                     // Display title
  description: string;               // Short description
  category: IndicatorCategory;       // Category classification
  icon: string;                      // Icon name from lucide-react
  score?: number;                    // Current score (0-100)
  maxScore: number;                  // Maximum possible score (100)
  status: IndicatorStatus;           // good | warning | critical | neutral
  lastAnalyzed?: string;             // ISO timestamp
  trend?: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral'; // Score trend direction
  trendValue?: number;               // Percentage change
}

type IndicatorCategory = 'Rankings' | 'Traffic' | 'Technical' | 'Content' | 'Backlinks';
type IndicatorStatus = 'good' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'neutral';
```

### Category Filter Tabs

| Category | Indicators | Description |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| All | All 17 | Default view showing all indicators |
| Rankings | 4 | Keyword Rankings, SERP Features, Visibility Score, Competitor Rankings |
| Traffic | 3 | Organic Traffic, Click-Through Rate, Bounce Rate |
| Technical | 5 | Page Speed, Mobile Friendly, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals, Crawlability |
| Content | 3 | Meta Tags, Headings, Image Alt Text |
| Backlinks | 2 | Backlink Count, Domain Authority |

### Responsive Grid Layout

| Viewport | Default Columns | Example Configuration |
|----------|-----------------|----------------------|
| Mobile (< 640px) | 1 column | `{ default: 1 }` |
| Small (640px+) | 2 columns | `{ sm: 2 }` |
| Medium (768px+) | 3 columns | `{ md: 3 }` |
| Large (1024px+) | 4 columns | `{ lg: 4 }` |
| XL (1280px+) | 4 columns | `{ xl: 4 }` |
| 2XL (1536px+) | 4 columns | `{ '2xl': 4 }` |

### Card Visual Elements

**IndicatorCard Components:**
| Element | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Icon | Category-specific icon from lucide-react |
| Title | Indicator name |
| Score | Percentage score with progress bar |
| Status Badge | Color-coded status indicator |
| Description | Short indicator description |
| Trend Arrow | Up/down/neutral trend indicator |
| Last Analyzed | Relative time since last analysis |

**Status Badge Colors:**
| Status | Background | Text | Icon |
|--------|------------|------|------|
| Good | `bg-green-100` | `text-green-800` | ✓ CircleCheckBig |
| Warning | `bg-yellow-100` | `text-yellow-800` | ⚠ TriangleAlert |
| Critical | `bg-red-100` | `text-red-800` | ✕ CircleX |
| Neutral | `bg-gray-100` | `text-gray-800` | − Minus |

### Loading States

| State | Display |
|-------|---------|
| Initial Load | IndicatorCatalogSkeleton with configurable card count |
| Refresh | Pulse animation on cards being updated |
| Error | Error boundary with retry button |
| Empty | EmptyState component with "No indicators" message |

### Accessibility Implementation

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| ARIA Labels | Comprehensive labels on all interactive elements |
| Keyboard Navigation | Tab through cards, Enter to activate |
| Screen Reader | Status and score announced |
| Focus Indicators | Visible focus ring on cards |
| Skip Link | Skip to main content link |

**ARIA Label Format:**
```
"{title}: {score}%. {description}. Status: {status}"
```

### Performance Optimizations

| Optimization | Implementation |
|--------------|----------------|
| Lazy Loading | Cards rendered on scroll intersection |
| Memoization | React.memo on IndicatorCard |
| Virtualization | Considered for 50+ indicators |
| Image Optimization | Icons loaded from lucide-react (SVG) |

## Design System Reference (TASK-28-19)

### Description
Comprehensive design system documentation including color tokens, typography, spacing, component patterns, and accessibility guidelines. Provides single source of truth for all UI/UX decisions and ensures consistency across the application.

### Documentation Location
- **Design System Doc:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`
- **CSS Variables:** `frontend/app/globals.css`
- **Tailwind Config:** `tailwind.config.ts`

### Design Tokens Overview

**Color System:**
| Category | Variables | Count |
|----------|-----------|-------|
| Brand Colors | `--brand-primary`, `--brand-secondary`, `--brand-accent` | 3 |
| Semantic Colors | `--success`, `--warning`, `--error`, `--info` | 4 |
| Surface Layers | `--surface-0` through `--surface-3` | 4 |
| Base Colors | `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--border` | 12 |

**Typography:**
| Category | Tokens | Count |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Font Families | `--font-geist-sans`, `--font-geist-mono` | 2 |
| Font Sizes | `text-xs` through `text-5xl` | 8 |
| Font Weights | `font-normal` through `font-bold` | 4 |

**Spacing:**
| Category | Tokens | Base Unit |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Spacing Scale | `p-1` through `p-16` | 4px |
| Gap Scale | `gap-1` through `gap-16` | 4px |

### Component Patterns

**Button Variants:**
| Variant | Usage | Classes |
|---------|-------|---------|
| Primary | Main CTAs | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` |
| Secondary | Secondary actions | `bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground` |
| Destructive | Delete, remove | `bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground` |
| Outline | Tertiary actions | `border border-input bg-background` |
| Ghost | Minimal actions | `hover:bg-accent` |
| Link | Text links | `text-primary underline-offset-4` |

**Status Indicators:**
| Status | Color | Usage |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Good | `--success` | Positive states, scores ≥80% |
| Warning | `--warning` | Caution states, scores 50-79% |
| Critical | `--error` | Error states, scores <50% |
| Neutral | `--muted-foreground` | No data, pending |

### Tailwind Integration

Colors are integrated via the `@theme` directive:

```css
@theme inline {
  --color-brand-primary: var(--brand-primary);
  --color-success: var(--success);
  --color-surface-0: var(--surface-0);
  /* ... etc */
}
```

**Usage in Components:**
```tsx
<button className="bg-brand-primary text-white">
  Primary Button
</button>

<div className="bg-surface-2 border-border rounded-lg">
  Card content
</div>
```

### Dark Mode

All color variables have dark mode counterparts applied via the `.dark` class:

```css
:root {
  --background: oklch(1 0 0);  /* Light mode */
}

.dark {
  --background: oklch(0.145 0 0);  /* Dark mode */
}
```

### Accessibility Guidelines

| Guideline | Implementation |
|-----------|---------------|
| Color Contrast | WCAG 2.1 AA minimum (4.5:1 for text) |
| Focus Indicators | 2px ring with offset |
| ARIA Labels | Required for all interactive elements |
| Keyboard Navigation | Tab, Enter, Space, Escape support |
| Reduced Motion | Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` |

```typescript
interface HeaderProps {
  logo?: React.ReactNode;
  navigation?: NavItem[];
  showAuth?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

interface NavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  icon?: string;
  badge?: string | number;
}
```

**Features:**
- Fixed position at top of viewport
- Logo with home link
- Primary navigation links
- Authentication buttons (Login/Register)

- Responsive: collapses to hamburger on mobile

**Navigation Links:**

**MobileNav Component:**
```typescript
interface MobileNavProps {
  navigation?: NavItem[];
  trigger?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}
```

**Features:**
- Sheet component (slide-in from left)
- Hamburger menu trigger
- Full navigation menu
- User profile section
- Logout button

| Property | Value |

## Comparison Types and Interfaces (TASK-32-1)

### Description
TypeScript interfaces and type guards for the competitor comparison system. Foundation module that defines all data structures used in programmatic SEO comparison landing pages targeting keywords like "SEOIndicator vs [competitor]". Part of the Competitor Comparison Landing Pages feature (FEAT-032).

### Component Location
- **Types File:** `frontend/lib/compare/types.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/lib/compare/types.test.ts`

### Core Interfaces

| Interface | Purpose | Required Properties |
|-----------|---------|-------------------|
| `CompetitorData` | Complete competitor data structure | id, name, slug, website, tagline, pricing, features, pros, cons, useCases, lastUpdated, source |
| `PricingTier` | Pricing tier with monthly/annual options | name, monthlyPrice, annualPrice, features |
| `FeatureCategory` | Feature grouping for comparison tables | name, features[] |
| `Feature` | Individual feature comparison | name, seoindicator, competitor |
| `UseCase` | Target audience use case | title, description, audience, budget |
| `ComparisonData` | Full comparison page data | slug, title, metaDescription, competitors, summary, featureComparison, pricingComparison, prosCons, useCases, verdict, faqs, relatedComparisons |
| `FAQ` | Frequently asked question | question, answer |

### Component Props Interfaces

| Interface | Purpose | Props |
|-----------|---------|-------|
| `ComparisonTableProps` | Feature comparison table | features, highlightWinner?, showTooltips? |
| `PricingComparisonProps` | Pricing tier comparison | seoindicator, competitor, showFreeTier? |
| `ProsConsCardProps` | Pros/cons display card | tool, pros, cons, overallRating? |
| `UseCaseSectionProps` | Use case recommendations | seoindicator, competitor |
| `ComparisonCTAProps` | Call-to-action component | variant?, text?, href?, abTestGroup? |
| `ComparisonSchemaProps` | JSON-LD schema injection | comparison, faqs |
| `ComparisonPageProps` | Next.js dynamic route | params: { slug } |

### Type Guards

| Function | Validates | Returns |
|----------|-----------|---------|
| `isPricingTier(value)` | PricingTier interface | boolean |
| `isFeature(value)` | Feature interface | boolean |
| `isFeatureCategory(value)` | FeatureCategory interface | boolean |
| `isUseCase(value)` | UseCase interface | boolean |
| `isCompetitorData(value)` | CompetitorData interface | boolean |
| `isFAQ(value)` | FAQ interface | boolean |
| `isComparisonData(value)` | ComparisonData interface | boolean |

### Constants

| Constant | Type | Values |
|----------|------|--------|
| `AUDIENCE_TYPES` | readonly tuple | 'solo', 'small-team', 'enterprise', 'agency' |
| `BUDGET_TYPES` | readonly tuple | 'free', 'budget', 'mid-range', 'premium' |

### PricingTier Interface Details

```typescript
interface PricingTier {
  name: string;                      // 'Lite', 'Pro', 'Enterprise'
  monthlyPrice: number | 'Free';     // Monthly cost or 'Free'
  annualPrice: number | 'Free';      // Annual cost or 'Free'
  features: string[];                // Features included in tier
  highlighted?: boolean;             // UI highlight flag
}
```

### Feature Interface Details

```typescript
interface Feature {
  name: string;                      // Feature name
  seoindicator: boolean | string;    // true, false, 'Yes', 'Partial', 'N/A'
  competitor: boolean | string;      // Competitor's support level
  tooltip?: string;                  // Optional explanation
}
```

### ComparisonData Interface Details

```typescript
interface ComparisonData {
  slug: string;                      // 'seoindicator-vs-ahrefs'
  title: string;                     // Page title for SEO
  metaDescription: string;           // SEO meta description
  competitors: [string, string];     // Exactly 2 competitor IDs
  summary: string;                   // Executive summary
  featureComparison: FeatureCategory[];
  pricingComparison: {
    seoindicator: PricingTier[];
    competitor: PricingTier[];
  };
  prosCons: {
    seoindicator: { pros: string[]; cons: string[] };
    competitor: { pros: string[]; cons: string[] };
  };
  useCases: {
    seoindicator: UseCase[];
    competitor: UseCase[];
  };
  verdict: string;                   // Honest recommendation
  faqs: FAQ[];
  relatedComparisons: string[];      // Slugs of related pages
}
```

### Type Guard Implementation Pattern

```typescript
export function isPricingTier(value: unknown): value is PricingTier {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;
  
  const obj = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  
  if (typeof obj.name !== 'string') return false;
  
  const monthlyPrice = obj.monthlyPrice;
  if (typeof monthlyPrice !== 'number' && monthlyPrice !== 'Free') return false;
  
  // ... additional validation
  
  return true;
}
```

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| No `any` Types | All interfaces use strict typing |
| Runtime Validation | Type guards validate unknown data |
| Input Sanitization | Type guards reject invalid types |
| Constants | readonly tuples prevent mutation |

## OG Image Generation for Comparisons (TASK-32-17)

### Feature Description
Dynamic Open Graph image generation for comparison pages to improve social sharing appearance. Pre-generates static OG images at build time for all 13 comparison slugs, ensuring compatibility with Next.js static export (`output: 'export'`).

### Component Locations
- **OG Images:** `frontend/public/og/compare/{slug}.png` (13 images)
- **Generation Script:** `frontend/scripts/generate-og-images.mjs`
- **OG Utility:** `frontend/lib/compare/og-images.ts`
- **API Route (fallback):** `frontend/app/api/og/route.tsx`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/api/og/route.test.tsx`

### Implementation Strategy

The implementation uses **pre-generated static images** rather than runtime generation due to Next.js static export constraints. The `ImageResponse` class from `next/og` requires server-side rendering and is incompatible with `output: 'export'`.

| Approach | Status | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Pre-generated static images | ✅ Implemented | Build-time generation |
| Dynamic API route | ❌ Not used | Incompatible with static export |

### Build Script

**Command:** `npm run build:og` (integrated into `npm run build`)

**Technology Stack:**
| Library | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `satori` | JSX to SVG conversion |
| `@resvg/resvg-js` | SVG to PNG rendering |

**Generation Process:**
1. Read all comparison slugs from registry (`COMPARISON_SLUGS`)
2. Generate JSX template with competitor names
3. Convert JSX to SVG using satori
4. Render SVG to PNG using resvg-js
5. Save to `/public/og/compare/{slug}.png`

### OG Metadata Integration

Comparison pages include OG image metadata via `getComparisonOGMetadata()`:

```typescript
// In comparison page metadata
export async function generateMetadata({ params }): Promise<Metadata> {
  const comparison = getComparisonBySlug(params.slug);
  const ogImageUrl = `https://seoindicator.com/og/compare/${params.slug}.png`;
  
  return {
    openGraph: {
      images: [{ url: ogImageUrl, width: 1200, height: 630 }],
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      images: [ogImageUrl],
    },
  };
}
```

**File:** `frontend/lib/compare/og-images.ts`

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `getComparisonOGImage(slug)` | Returns OG image URL for a comparison slug |
| `getAllOGImages()` | Returns all OG image URLs for sitemap |

### Security Implementation

| HTML Tag Stripping | Removes `<script>`, `<img>`, and other tags |
| JavaScript Removal | Strips `javascript:` and `on*=` handlers |
| Name Truncation | Limits competitor names to 50 characters |
| URL Encoding | Safe handling of encoded parameters |
| Unicode Support | Handles emoji and special characters |

Key conversion component highlighting SEOIndicator's free tier advantage.

### Core Functionalities

| Free Tier Highlight | SEOIndicator free tier prominently displayed with "Free Forever" badge |
| Billing Toggle | Switch between monthly and annual pricing |
| Feature Breakdown | Show features included in each tier |
| Annual Savings | Calculate and display savings percentage for annual plans |
| Mobile Responsive | Grid stacks to single column on mobile devices |
| Highlighted Tier | "Popular" badge with emerald accent styling |

### Sub-components

| `BillingToggle` | Monthly/Annual switch with accessible aria-pressed states |

| `PricingCard` | Individual tier card with features and pricing |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface PricingComparisonProps {
  seoindicator: PricingTier[];      // SEOIndicator pricing tiers
  competitor: PricingTier[];        // Competitor pricing tiers
  showFreeTier?: boolean;           // Show free tier highlight (default: true)
}

interface PricingTier {
  name: string;                     // Tier name (Free, Pro, Enterprise)
  monthlyPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';  // Monthly price
  annualPrice: number | 'Free' | 'Custom';   // Annual price (per month)
  features: string[];               // Features included in tier
  highlighted?: boolean;            // Highlight as "Popular" tier
}
```

### Price Formatting

| Price Type | Display Format |
|------------|----------------|
| `Free` | "Free Forever" badge |
| `Custom` | "Custom" text (no savings badge) |
| Integer (e.g., 29) | "$29" |
| Decimal (e.g., 19.99) | "$19.99" |

### Annual Savings Calculation

```typescript
// Formula: ((monthly * 12 - annual * 12) / (monthly * 12)) * 100
const savingsPercent = ((monthlyPrice * 12 - annualPrice * 12) / (monthlyPrice * 12)) * 100;
```

### Styling

- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling
- Mobile: `grid-cols-1` (stacked layout)
- Desktop: `grid-cols-2` (side-by-side)
- Highlighted tier: "Popular" badge with emerald accent
- Free tier: "Free Forever" badge with distinct styling
- Savings badge: Shows percentage saved with annual billing

## Audit Visibility Columns (TASK-33-1)

### Service Description
Database migration adding visibility control columns to the audits table. Enables public sharing of audit reports via unique URLs while maintaining privacy by default. Foundation for the Public Audit Sharing feature (FEAT-033).

### Database Schema Addition

**Migration:** `2026_03_05_201400_add_visibility_columns_to_audits_table.php`

**New Columns:**

| Column | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `visibility` | ENUM('private', 'public') | 'private' | Controls audit visibility |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | NULL | Unique hash for public URL (nullable) |
| `public_hash_created_at` | TIMESTAMP | NULL | When the public link was created |

**Full Audit Schema (with new columns):**
```sql
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN visibility ENUM('private', 'public') DEFAULT 'private';
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN public_hash VARCHAR(64) NULL;
ALTER TABLE audits ADD COLUMN public_hash_created_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

-- Index for fast public lookups
CREATE INDEX idx_audits_public_hash ON audits(public_hash);

-- Index for visibility filtering
CREATE INDEX idx_audits_visibility ON audits(visibility);
```

### Column Details

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `visibility` | ENUM | `private` (default) = only owner can view, `public` = accessible via public URL |
| `public_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | SHA-256 hash for unique public URL, generated when audit is made public |
| `public_hash_created_at` | TIMESTAMP | Audit trail for when public link was created |

### Public URL Pattern

When an audit is made public, the accessible URL pattern is:
````
/public-audit/{public_hash}
````
Example:
````
/public-audit/a1b2c3d4e5f6...
````

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| Privacy by Default | `visibility` defaults to `'private'` |
| Unique Hash | 64-character cryptographic hash (SHA-256) |
| No Enumeration | Hash is not guessable, prevents enumeration attacks |
| Audit Trail | `public_hash_created_at` tracks when link was created |
| Index Optimization | Indexed for O(1) lookup performance |

### Model Changes

**Audit Model Updates:**
```php
protected `` = [
    // ... existing fields
    'visibility',
    'public_hash',
    'public_hash_created_at',
];

protected `` = [
    'visibility' => 'string',
    'public_hash_created_at' => 'datetime',
];

// Scopes
public function scopePublic(``) {
    return ``->where('visibility', 'public');
}

public function scopePrivate(``) {
    return ``->where('visibility', 'private');
}

// Helper Methods
public function isPublic(): bool {
    return ``->visibility === 'public';
}

public function getPublicUrl(): ?string {
    return ``->public_hash 
        ? url("/public-audit/{``->public_hash}")
        : null;
}
```

## TopIssues Component (TASK-33-11)

### Component Description
React component that displays a prioritized list of SEO issues found during the audit, with severity indicators and "View full report" prompt for anonymous users. Shows top 5 issues for anonymous users (isPartial=true) and the full issue list for logged-in owners (isPartial=false). Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **Component:** `frontend/components/audit/TopIssues.tsx`
- **Exports:** `frontend/components/audit/index.ts` (TopIssues, TopIssuesProps, Issue)
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/components/audit/TopIssues.test.tsx`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Limited View | Top 5 issues for anonymous users (isPartial=true) |
| Full View | All issues for logged-in owners (isPartial=false) |
| Severity Indicators | Critical (red), Warning (yellow), Info (blue) icons |
| Category Badges | Technical, On-Page, Content, Mobile category labels |
| Issue Expansion | Click to expand/collapse issue details |
| View Full Report | CTA prompt with remaining count for anonymous users |
| Empty State | Checkmark icon when no issues found |
| Accessibility | Full ARIA support with keyboard navigation |

### Component Props

```typescript
interface TopIssuesProps {
  issues: Issue[];          // Array of SEO issues to display
  isPartial: boolean;       // true = show only 5 issues (anonymous user)
  auditHash?: string;       // Optional hash for "View full report" link
}

interface Issue {
  id: string;               // Unique issue identifier
  title: string;            // Issue title/heading
  description: string;      // Detailed issue description
  severity: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'info';  // Severity level
  category: string;         // Issue category (Technical, On-Page, etc.)
  impact: string;           // Impact description
}
```

### Severity Indicators

| Severity | Icon | Color | Description |
|----------|------|-------|-------------|
| `critical` | AlertTriangle | Red (text-red-500) | Critical issues requiring immediate attention |
| `warning` | AlertCircle | Yellow (text-yellow-500) | Warnings that should be addressed |
| `info` | Info | Blue (text-blue-500) | Informational suggestions |

### Category Badges

| Category | Badge Style |
|----------|-------------|
| Technical | Default badge |
| On-Page | Default badge |
| Content | Default badge |
| Mobile | Default badge |

### Sorting Logic

Issues are sorted by:
1. **Severity** (Critical → Warning → Info)
2. **Category** (alphabetical within same severity)

### UI Behavior

**Anonymous User (isPartial=true):**
- Shows top 5 issues (sorted by severity)

- Links to `/audit/{auditHash}` for full access

**Logged-in Owner (isPartial=false):**
- Shows all issues
- No "View full report" prompt
- Full expandable details for each issue

**Empty State:**
- Displays checkmark icon with "No issues found" message

- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling

## Meta Tags and OG Tags for Public Audits (TASK-33-25)

### Feature Description
Comprehensive meta tags and Open Graph tags implementation for public audit pages. Enables SEO optimization and social sharing for public audit URLs, driving organic traffic and improving click-through rates from search engines and social platforms. Part of the Public SEO Audit Reports & Embeddable Score Widget feature (FEAT-033).

### Component Location
- **Implementation:** `frontend/app/audit/[hash]/AuditPageClient.tsx` - `updateMetadata()` function
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/app/audit/[hash]/metadata.test.tsx`
- **Test Documentation:** `PROJECT-SEOINDICATOR/TESTS/TEST-33-25.md`

### Core Functionalities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Dynamic Title Generation | `{truncatedUrl} SEO Audit Report \| SEOIndicator` |
| Meta Description | Score and URL inclusion with SEO-optimized length |
| Robots Meta | `index, follow` for public, `noindex` for errors |
| Canonical URL | HTTPS with trailing slash and hash |
| Open Graph Tags | og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type |
| Twitter Card Tags | twitter:card with summary_large_image |

### Meta Tag Structure

**Title Generation:**
```html
<title>{truncatedUrl} SEO Audit Report | SEOIndicator</title>
```
- URL truncated to 40 chars for display (title max 70 chars)
- Protocol stripping (https:// → removed)

**Meta Description:**
```html
<meta name="description" content="SEO audit for {url} - Score: {score}/100. View technical SEO analysis and recommendations.">
```
- SEO-optimized length (50-160 chars)

**Robots Meta:**
```html
<!-- Valid public audit -->
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">

<!-- Invalid/not found audit -->
<meta name="robots" content="noindex">
```

**Canonical URL:**
```html
<link rel="canonical" href="https://seoindicator.com/audit/{hash}/">
```

### Open Graph Tags

```html
<meta property="og:title" content="{url} SEO Score: {score}/100">
<meta property="og:description" content="SEO audit results for {url}">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://seoindicator.com/badge/{hash}/og.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://seoindicator.com/audit/{hash}/">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
```

**OG Image Dimensions:** 1200x630px (standard social sharing size)

### Twitter Card Tags

```html
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="{url} SEO Score: {score}/100">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="SEO audit results for {url}">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://seoindicator.com/badge/{hash}/og.png">
```

### Dynamic Generation

**Implementation via `updateMetadata()` function:**
```typescript
function updateMetadata(data: PublicAuditData | null) {
  if (!data) {
    // Set noindex for invalid audits
    document.querySelector('meta[name="robots"]')?.setAttribute('content', 'noindex');
    return;
  }

  // Generate dynamic title with truncation
  const displayUrl = truncateUrl(data.siteUrl, 40);
  const title = `${displayUrl} SEO Audit Report | SEOIndicator`;
  
  // Update document title
  document.title = title;
  
  // Update meta tags
  updateMetaTag('description', `SEO audit for ${data.siteUrl} - Score: ${data.overallScore}/100...`);
  updateMetaTag('robots', 'index, follow');
  updateLinkTag('canonical', `${siteUrl}/audit/${hash}/`);
  
  // Update OG tags
  updateMetaProperty('og:title', `${data.siteUrl} SEO Score: ${data.overallScore}/100`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:description', `SEO audit results for ${data.siteUrl}`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:image', `${siteUrl}/badge/${hash}/og.png`);
  updateMetaProperty('og:url', `${siteUrl}/audit/${hash}/`);
  
  // Update Twitter card tags
  updateMetaName('twitter:card', 'summary_large_image');
  // ... mirrors OG tags
}
```

### URL Truncation Logic

| Input | Output | Reason |
|-------|--------|--------|
| `https://example.com` | `example.com` | Protocol stripped |
| `https://very-long-domain-name-here.com` | `very-long-domain-name-here.com` | Full domain shown if < 40 chars |
| `https://extremely-long-domain-name-that-exceeds-limit.com` | `extremely-long-domain-name-that-...` | Truncated with ellipsis |

**Truncation Rules:**
- Maximum display length: 40 characters
- Protocol (https://) stripped before truncation
- Ellipsis (...) added if truncated
- Title max: 70 characters total

### Security Implementation

| Security Measure | Implementation |
|------------------|----------------|
| XSS Prevention | HTML escaping for all dynamic content |
| URL Sanitization | Protocol validation, special chars escaped |
| No Sensitive Data | Only public audit data exposed in meta tags |
| Injection Protection | All values sanitized before DOM update |

### SEO Benefits

| Benefit | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Search Indexing | `index, follow` allows Google to crawl and index |
| SERP CTR | Compelling title and description improve click rates |
| Social Sharing | OG tags control appearance on Facebook, LinkedIn, etc. |
| Twitter Sharing | Twitter card tags enable rich previews on X |
| Canonical URL | Prevents duplicate content issues |
| Unique Per Audit | Each hash generates unique metadata |

## Tier 2 Competitor Data (TASK-32-12)

### Feature Description
Tier 2 competitor data files for the Competitor Comparison Landing Pages feature (FEAT-032). Provides structured data for Mangools, Serpstat, SpyFu, and SE Ranking - medium search volume competitors that expand comparison coverage. Each file exports a `CompetitorData` object with pricing, features, pros/cons, and use cases.

### Component Locations
- **Mangools:** `frontend/lib/compare/competitors/mangools.ts`
- **Serpstat:** `frontend/lib/compare/competitors/serpstat.ts`
- **SpyFu:** `frontend/lib/compare/competitors/spyfu.ts`
- **SE Ranking:** `frontend/lib/compare/competitors/seranking.ts`
- **Tests:** `frontend/__tests__/lib/compare/competitors/tier2-competitors.test.ts`
- **Test Documentation:** `TESTS/TEST-32-12.md`

### Tier 2 Competitors Summary

| Competitor | Focus | Starting Price | Annual Price | Target Audience |
|------------|-------|---------------|--------------|-----------------|
| Mangools | Simplicity, beginners | $29/mo | $19.90/mo | Solo, Small teams |
| Serpstat | All-in-one, database | $69/mo | Custom | Small teams, Agencies |
| SpyFu | Competitor spying, PPC | $39/mo | Custom | Agencies, PPC focus |
| SE Ranking | Rank tracking, agencies | $52/mo | Custom | Agencies, SMBs |

### Competitor Data Structure

Each competitor exports a `CompetitorData` object following the interface from TASK-32-1:

```typescript
interface CompetitorData {
  id: string;              // Unique identifier (e.g., 'mangools')
  name: string;            // Display name (e.g., 'Mangools')
  slug: string;            // URL-friendly slug (e.g., 'mangools')
  website: string;         // Official website URL
  logo?: string;           // Optional logo path
  tagline: string;         // Short description
  pricing: PricingTier[];  // Pricing tiers with features
  features: FeatureCategory[]; // Feature comparison by category
  pros: string[];          // Honest pros list
  cons: string[];          // Honest cons list
  useCases: UseCase[];     // Target audience recommendations
  lastUpdated: string;     // ISO date of last update
  source: string;          // Data source URL
}
```

### Mangools Data Highlights

**Pricing Tiers (3):**
| Tier | Monthly | Annual | Key Features |
|------|---------|--------|--------------|
| Entry | $29 | $19.90 | 25 keyword lookups/day, 100 SERP lookups/day |
| Premium | $49 | $39.90 | 100 keyword lookups/day, 300 SERP lookups/day |
| Agency | $129 | $99.90 | 500 keyword lookups/day, 1000 SERP lookups/day |

**Tool Suite:** KWFinder, SERPChecker, SERPWatcher, LinkMiner, SiteProfiler

**Positioning:** Beginner-focused with simple UI, affordable for solopreneurs

| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Unlimited, dedicated support |

**Database:** Large keyword database with clustering and batch analysis

**Positioning:** All-in-one SEO platform with strong database coverage

### Positioning Notes

**Mangools:** Emphasize simplicity and beginner-friendliness. Pros include user-friendly interface and affordable pricing. Cons include limited advanced features and smaller database.

**Serpstat:** Emphasize all-in-one platform and database size. Pros include comprehensive feature set and keyword clustering. Cons include steeper learning curve and higher starting price.

**SpyFu:** Emphasize competitor intelligence and PPC data. Pros include unique Kombat feature and unlimited searches on higher tiers. Cons include less focus on content SEO and smaller keyword database.

**SE Ranking:** Emphasize agency features and rank tracking accuracy. Pros include white-label reports and team collaboration. Cons include fewer content marketing features compared to competitors.

|------------|-------|---------------|--------------|-----------------|

| BrightEdge | Enterprise AI SEO | Custom | Custom | Enterprise |
| Conductor | Content marketing | Custom | Custom | Enterprise |
| Wincher | Rank tracking | Free | Free | Solopreneurs, Small business |

### Enterprise Pricing Handling

BrightEdge and Conductor use `monthlyPrice: 'Custom'` and `annualPrice: 'Custom'` to indicate enterprise pricing:

```typescript
pricing: [
  {
    name: 'Enterprise',
    monthlyPrice: 'Custom',
    annualPrice: 'Custom',
    features: ['Custom pricing', 'Dedicated support', ...],
    highlighted: true,
  },
],
```

This distinguishes enterprise tools from tools with published pricing.
